def _assign_entity_context(entity, client, commit):
    """Assign client and commit context to an entity."""
    if client and not getattr(entity, 'client', None):
        entity.client = client
    if not getattr(entity, 'commit', None):
        revision = "UNCOMMITTED"
        if hasattr(entity, '_label') and entity._label:
            revision = entity._label.rsplit("@", maxsplit=1)[-1]
        if revision == "UNCOMMITTED":
            entity.commit = commit
        elif client:
            entity.commit = client.repository.get_commit(revision)

def _to_str_or_none(data):
    """Convert data to string or return None."""
    return str(data) if data is not None else None

def _create_project_identifier(client, project_name, creator):
    """Generate unique identifier for a project based on repository details."""
    # Determine hostname for resource URIs
    # Priority: RENKU_DOMAIN env > remote host > localhost
    default_host = "localhost"
    
    if not creator:
        raise ValueError("Project Creator not set")
    
    owner = creator.email.split("@")[0] if creator.email else "unknown"
    
    actual_host = default_host
    actual_owner = owner
    actual_name = project_name
    
    if client and hasattr(client, 'remote') and client.remote:
        actual_host = client.remote.get("host") or actual_host
        actual_owner = client.remote.get("owner") or actual_owner
        actual_name = client.remote.get("name") or actual_name
    
    # Override with environment variable if set
    actual_host = os.environ.get("RENKU_DOMAIN") or actual_host
    
    if actual_name:
        actual_name = url_encode(actual_name, safe="")
    else:
        raise ValueError("Project name not set")
    
    # Construct project URL
    project_url = urljoin(f"https://{actual_host}", pl.posixpath.join(PROJECT_URL_PATH, actual_owner, actual_name))
    return project_url

@attr.s(slots=True)
class Project:
    """Represents a project in the system."""
    name = attr.ib(default=None)
    created = attr.ib(converter=parse_date)
    version = attr.ib(converter=str, default=str(SUPPORTED_PROJECT_VERSION))
    agent_version = attr.ib(converter=str, default="pre-0.11.0")
    template_source = attr.ib(type=str, default=None)
    template_ref = attr.ib(type=str, default=None)
    template_id = attr.ib(type=str, default=None)
    template_version = attr.ib(type=str, default=None)
    template_metadata = attr.ib(type=str, default="{}")
    immutable_template_files = attr.ib(factory=list)
    automated_update = attr.ib(converter=bool, default=True)
    client = attr.ib(default=None)
    creator = attr.ib(default=None, kw_only=True)
    _id = attr.ib(kw_only=True, default=None)
    _metadata_path = attr.ib(default=None, init=False)
    
    @created.default
    def _current_timestamp(self):
        """Provide current UTC timestamp as default."""
        return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    
    def __attrs_post_init__(self):
        """Initialize computed attributes after creation."""
        if not self.creator and self.client:
            old_metadata_path = self.client.renku_path.joinpath(OLD_METADATA_PATH)
            if old_metadata_path.exists():
                self.creator = Person.from_commit(
                    self.client.repository.get_previous_commit(old_metadata_path, first=True)
                )
            else:
                # Assume project is newly created
                self.creator = Person.from_repository(self.client.repository)
        
        try:
            self._id = self.project_identifier
        except ValueError:
            """Fallback to old behaviour."""
            if self._id:
                pass
            elif self.client and self.client.is_project_set():
                self._id = self.client.project._id
            else:
                raise
    
    @property
    def project_identifier(self):
        """Return the unique identifier for the project."""
        return _create_project_identifier(client=self.client, project_name=self.name, creator=self.creator)
    
    @classmethod
    def from_yaml(cls, path, client=None):
        """Create an instance from a YAML file."""
        data = jsonld.read_yaml(path)
        self = cls.from_jsonld(data=data, client=client)
        self._metadata_path = path
        return self
    
    @classmethod
    def from_jsonld(cls, data, client=None):
        """Create an instance from JSON-LD data."""
        if isinstance(data, cls):
            return data
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ValueError(data)
        return ProjectSchema(client=client).load(data)
    
    def to_yaml(self, path=None):
        """Write an instance to the referenced YAML file."""
        from renku import __version__
        self.agent_version = __version__
        self._metadata_path = path or self._metadata_path
        data = ProjectSchema().dump(self)
        jsonld.write_yaml(path=self._metadata_path, data=data)

class Manager:

        super().__init__()
        self._occupied = False
        self._scheduler = uasyncio.get_event_loop()

class BasicManager(Manager, Observer):
    def __init__(self, sensor: ADCReader, device: Actuator):
        super().__init__()
        self.device = device
        self._triggered_once = False
        sensor.add_observer(self)

    def notify(self, new_reading):
        self._scheduler.create_task(self.process(new_reading))

    def prerequisites_met(self) -> bool:
        return (self.device.is_ready or self._occupied) and self._active

    def clear_state(self):
        self.device.turn_off()
        self.device.release()
        self._triggered_once = False
        self._occupied = False

    def deactivate(self):
        self._active = False
        print('{} deactivated'.format(self.__class__.__name__))
        if self._occupied:
            self.clear_state()

    def on_first_detection(self):
        self._occupied = True
        self.device.clamp()
        self._triggered_once = True

    async def process(self, current_reading):
        raise NotImplementedError


class HumidityManager(BasicManager):
    def __init__(self, sensor: MoistureReader, pump: Pump, min_level: int, max_level: int,
                 duration_on: int, cooldown_time: int):
        super().__init__(sensor, pump)
        self.sensor = sensor
        self.min_level = min_level
        self.max_level = max_level
        self.duration_on = duration_on
        self.cooldown_time = cooldown_time
        self.device.turn_off()

    def within_range(self, value) -> bool:
        return self.min_level <= value <= self.max_level

    def below_minimum(self, value) -> bool:
        return value < self.min_level

    def above_maximum(self, value) -> bool:
        return value > self.max_level

    async def operate_pump(self):
        self.device.turn_on()
        await uasyncio.sleep(self.duration_on)
        self.device.turn_off()
        await uasyncio.sleep(self.cooldown_time)

    async def process(self, reading):
        if not self.prerequisites_met():
            return

        if self.within_range(reading):
            self.clear_state()
            return

        if not self._triggered_once and self.below_minimum(reading):
            print('Moisture {} < {} !'.format(reading, self.min_level))
            self._triggered_once = True

        while not self.above_maximum(self.sensor.read()):
            self.device.clamp()
            await self.operate_pump()
        self.clear_state()


class IlluminationManager(BasicManager):
    def __init__(self, sensor: LightReader, lamp: LED, target_level: int):
        super().__init__(sensor, lamp)
        self.target_level = target_level
        self.device.turn_off()

    def compute_intensity(self, light_reading) -> int:
        deficit = self.target_level - light_reading
        return int(deficit * 100 / self.target_level)

    async def process(self, reading):
        if not self.prerequisites_met():
            return

        if reading >= self.target_level:
            self.clear_state()
            return

        if not self._triggered_once:
            print('Illumination {} < {} !'.format(reading, self.target_level))
            self.on_first_detection()

        self.device.set_brightness(self.compute_intensity(reading))

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.nn.init import orthogonal_

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    multiplier = 1
    
    def __init__(self, input_channels, output_channels, stride=1, projection=None):
        super(ResidualBlock, self).__init__()
        self.main_path = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(input_channels, output_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(output_channels),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv1d(output_channels, output_channels * self.multiplier, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(output_channels * self.multiplier),
        )
        self.activation = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.projector = projection
        self.step = stride

    def forward(self, input_tensor):
        residual = input_tensor
        transformed = self.main_path(input_tensor)
        
        if self.projector is not None:
            residual = self.projector(input_tensor)
            
        result = transformed + residual
        return self.activation(result)


class FullyConnectedBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_features, output_features, hidden_units=256, dropout_rate=0.2):
        super(FullyConnectedBlock, self).__init__()
        self.input_dim = input_features
        self.output_dim = output_features
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_units
        
        self.layers = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.input_dim, self.hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, self.hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, self.output_dim)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        flattened = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
        return self.layers(flattened)


class ResLSTMSequenceModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, configuration):
        super(ResLSTMSequenceModel, self).__init__()
        
        # Extract and compute window parameters
        data_window_params = {
            "past_length": int(configuration['model_param']['past_time'] * configuration['data']['imu_freq']),
            "window_length": int(configuration['model_param']['window_time'] * configuration['data']['imu_freq']),
            "future_length": int(configuration['model_param']['future_time'] * configuration['data']['imu_freq']),
            "stride": int(configuration['data']['imu_freq'] // configuration['data']['sample_freq']),
        }
        
        # Model dimensions
        input_size = configuration['model_param']['input_dim']
        output_size = configuration['model_param']['output_dim']
        layer_counts = configuration['model_param']['layer_sizes']
        
        # LSTM settings
        self.lstm_hidden_size = configuration['model_param']['lstm_size']
        self.lstm_dropout_prob = configuration['model_param']['lstm_dropout']
        self.lstm_num_layers = configuration['model_param']['lstm_layers']
        
        # Compute total sequence length
        total_seq_len = (
            data_window_params["window_length"] +
            data_window_params["past_length"] +
            data_window_params["future_length"]
        )
        
        # ResNet configuration
        self.directions = 1
        self.resnet_output_channels = 128
        self.resnet_embedding_dim = self.resnet_output_channels * int(total_seq_len / 16 + 1)
        self.initial_filters = 64
        self.current_filter_count = self.initial_filters
        
        # Input processing
        self.input_processor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(input_size, self.initial_filters, kernel_size=7, stride=2, padding=3, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(self.initial_filters),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )
        
        # Stacked residual blocks
        self.residual_stacks = nn.Sequential(
            self.build_resnet_stack(ResidualBlock, 64, layer_counts[0], stride=1),
            self.build_resnet_stack(ResidualBlock, 128, layer_counts[1], stride=2),
            self.build_resnet_stack(ResidualBlock, 256, layer_counts[2], stride=2),
            self.build_resnet_stack(ResidualBlock, 512, layer_counts[3], stride=2),
        )
        
        # Final feature projection
        self.final_resnet_layer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(512, self.resnet_output_channels, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(self.resnet_output_channels),
        )
        
        # Sequence modeling
        self.sequence_model = nn.LSTM(
            self.resnet_embedding_dim,
            self.lstm_hidden_size,
            self.lstm_num_layers,
            batch_first=True,
            dropout=self.lstm_dropout_prob,
            bidirectional=False
        )
        
        # Output heads
        self.mean_head = FullyConnectedBlock(self.lstm_hidden_size, output_size)
        self.covariance_head = FullyConnectedBlock(self.lstm_hidden_size, output_size)
        
        # Initialize weights
        self.apply_weight_initialization()

    def freeze_covariance_branch(self):
        for parameter in self.covariance_head.parameters():
            parameter.requires_grad = False

    def unfreeze_all(self):
        for parameter in self.parameters():
            parameter.requires_grad = True

    def build_resnet_stack(self, block_class, filters, num_blocks, stride=1):
        downsample_layer = None
        
        if stride != 1 or self.current_filter_count != filters * block_class.multiplier:
            downsample_layer = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv1d(self.current_filter_count, filters * block_class.multiplier, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm1d(filters * block_class.multiplier)
            )
        
        layers_list = []
        layers_list.append(block_class(self.current_filter_count, filters, stride=stride, projection=downsample_layer))
        self.current_filter_count = filters * block_class.multiplier
        
        for _ in range(1, num_blocks):
            layers_list.append(block_class(self.current_filter_count, filters))
            
        return nn.Sequential(*layers_list)

    def apply_weight_initialization(self):
        for module in self.modules():
            if isinstance(module, nn.Conv1d):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(module.weight, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="relu")
            elif isinstance(module, nn.BatchNorm1d):
                nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1)
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            elif isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.normal_(module.weight, mean=0, std=0.01)
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            elif isinstance(module, nn.LSTM):
                # First layer initialization
                orthogonal_(module.weight_ih_l0)
                orthogonal_(module.weight_hh_l0)
                module.bias_ih_l0.data.zero_()
                module.bias_hh_l0.data.zero_()
                
                n = module.bias_hh_l0.size(0)
                start, end = n // 4, n // 2
                module.bias_hh_l0.data[start:end].fill_(1.0)
                
                # Second layer (if applicable)
                if self.lstm_num_layers > 1:
                    orthogonal_(module.weight_ih_l1)
                    orthogonal_(module.weight_hh_l1)
                    module.bias_ih_l1.data.zero_()
                    module.bias_hh_l1.data.zero_()
                    
                    n = module.bias_hh_l1.size(0)
                    start, end = n // 4, n // 2
                    module.bias_hh_l1.data[start:end].fill_(1.0)

    def initialize_hidden_state(self, input_data, batch_size, reset_state=False):
        param_device = next(self.parameters()).device
        dtype = next(self.parameters()).dtype
        
        if reset_state:
            h0 = torch.zeros(batch_size, self.lstm_num_layers * self.directions, self.lstm_hidden_size, 
                           device=input_data.device, dtype=dtype)
            c0 = torch.zeros(batch_size, self.lstm_num_layers * self.directions, self.lstm_hidden_size, 
                           device=input_data.device, dtype=dtype)
        else:
            h0 = torch.zeros(self.lstm_num_layers * self.directions, batch_size, self.lstm_hidden_size, 
                           device=input_data.device, dtype=dtype)
            c0 = torch.zeros(self.lstm_num_layers * self.directions, batch_size, self.lstm_hidden_size, 
                           device=input_data.device, dtype=dtype)
        
        return (h0, c0)

    def count_trainable_parameters(self):
        return sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters() if p.requires_grad)

    def forward(self, x, mode=None, hidden_state=None, cell_state=None):
        self.sequence_model.flatten_parameters()
        
        batch_size, sequence_length, channels, time_steps = x.shape
        
        # Reshape for temporal processing
        x = x.view(batch_size * sequence_length, channels, time_steps)
        
        # Process through ResNet backbone
        x = self.input_processor(x)
        x = self.residual_stacks(x)
        features = self.final_resnet_layer(x)
        
        # Prepare for LSTM
        features = features.view(batch_size, sequence_length, -1)
        
        # Handle hidden state initialization
        if hidden_state is None or cell_state is None:
            hidden_state, cell_state = self.initialize_hidden_state(x, batch_size)
        
        # Sequence modeling
        lstm_output, (hidden_final, cell_final) = self.sequence_model(features, (hidden_state, cell_state))
        lstm_output = lstm_output.contiguous().view(-1, self.lstm_hidden_size * self.directions)
        
        # Generate outputs
        mean_output = self.mean_head(lstm_output)
        mean_output = mean_output.view(batch_size, sequence_length, -1)
        
        if mode is None:
            covariance_output = self.covariance_head(lstm_output)
            covariance_output = covariance_output.view(batch_size, sequence_length, -1)
            return mean_output, covariance_output
        else:
            return mean_output

import libtorrent as lt
from pymongo import MongoClient
import os
from torrents.torrent_collection import TorrentCollection
from torrents.downloader import Downloader
from torrents.file import TorrentFile
from torrents.database import insert
from torrents.torrent import Torrent
from torrents.archive import Archive

def execute():
    # Set up database connection
    client = MongoClient()
    db = client.torwiz
    torrent_collection = db.torrents
    
    # Initialize torrent management system
    torrents = TorrentCollection(torrent_collection)
    prepare_database(torrent_collection)
    
    # Initialize BitTorrent session and downloader
    bt_session = lt.session()
    download_manager = Downloader()
    download_manager.start(bt_session)
    
    while True:
        # Refresh torrent list from database
        torrents.refresh()
        
        # Handle torrents scheduled for removal
        for torrent in torrents.to_be_removed():
            download_manager.remove(torrent.id)
        
        # Process completed torrents by archiving
        for torrent in torrents.completed():
            archive_path = torrent.files_dir() + '.zip'
            
            if not os.path.isfile(archive_path):
                archiver = Archive(archive_path)
                archiver.compress(torrent.files_dir())
        
        # Start pending torrents that haven't been initialized yet
        for torrent in torrents.pending():
            # Retrieve torrent file from source
            torrent_file = TorrentFile(torrent.id)
            torrent_file.fetch_from_url(torrent.source)
            
            # Add to downloader and update torrent info
            torrent.name = download_manager.enqueue(torrent.id, torrent_file.get_content())
            torrent.mark_as_started()
        
        # Update all torrent statuses
        for torrent in torrents:
            status_info = download_manager.status_for_id(torrent.id)
            torrent.apply_status(status_info)
        
        # Save updated torrent information to database
        torrents.save_changes()

def prepare_database(tordb):
    tordb.drop()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    execute()

# Unit tests for firebird.base.hooks - Modified test suite

from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Protocol, List, cast, Any
import unittest
from enum import Enum, auto
from firebird.base.hooks import hook_manager, HookFlag
from firebird.base.types import ANY

class TestEvents(Enum):
    INIT = auto()
    PERFORM = auto()

class Printable(Protocol):
    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
        ...

class BaseSubject:
    def __init__(self, owner: Printable, label: str, *, bind: bool=False,
                 by_class: bool=False, by_name: bool=False):
        self.owner = owner
        self.label: str = label
        if bind:
            hook_manager.register_name(self, label)
        target = self
        if by_class:
            target = BaseSubject
        elif by_name:
            target = label
        for callback in hook_manager.get_callbacks(TestEvents.INIT, target):
            try:
                callback(self, TestEvents.INIT)
            except Exception as err:
                self.owner.log(f"{self.label}.INIT callback result: FAIL ({err.args[0]})")
            else:
                self.owner.log(f"{self.label}.INIT callback result: SUCCESS")

    def execute(self):
        self.owner.log(f"{self.label}.PERFORM!")
        for callback in hook_manager.get_callbacks(TestEvents.PERFORM, self):
            try:
                callback(self, TestEvents.PERFORM)
            except Exception as err:
                self.owner.log(f"{self.label}.PERFORM callback result: FAIL ({err.args[0]})")
            else:
                self.owner.log(f"{self.label}.PERFORM callback result: SUCCESS")

class ExtendedSubject(BaseSubject):
    def super_execute(self):
        self.owner.log(f"{self.label}.SUPER-PERFORM!")
        for callback in hook_manager.get_callbacks('super-perform', self):
            try:
                callback(self, 'super-perform')
            except Exception as err:
                self.owner.log(f"{self.label}.SUPER-PERFORM callback result: FAIL ({err.args[0]})")
            else:
                self.owner.log(f"{self.label}.SUPER-PERFORM callback result: SUCCESS")

class TestCallback:
    def __init__(self, owner: Printable, tag: str):
        self.owner = owner
        self.tag: str = tag

    def trigger(self, subject: BaseSubject, event: TestEvents):
        self.owner.log(f"Callback {self.tag} triggered for {event.name if isinstance(event, Enum) else event} from {subject.label}")

    def failing_trigger(self, subject: BaseSubject, event: TestEvents):
        self.trigger(subject, event)
        raise RuntimeError("Callback failure")

def extract_properties(cls):
    """Generator yielding property names and their values from a class."""
    for name in vars(cls):
        attr = getattr(cls, name)
        if isinstance(attr, property):
            yield name, attr

def extract_constants(cls):
    """Generator yielding non-callable, non-private attribute names."""
    for name in vars(cls):
        value = getattr(cls, name)
        if not (isinstance(value, property) or callable(value)) and not name.startswith('_'):
            yield name

class HookTestSuite(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test suite for firebird.base.hooks.HookManager"""
    
    def __init__(self, methodName='runTest'):
        super().__init__(methodName)
        self.records: List[str] = []
        
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.records.clear()
        hook_manager.reset()
        
    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        pass
        
    def log(self, msg: str) -> None:
        self.records.append(msg)

    def test_basic_hooks(self):
        # Register subjects
        hook_manager.register_class(BaseSubject, TestEvents)
        self.assertEqual(tuple(hook_manager.hookables.keys()), (BaseSubject,))
        self.assertSetEqual(hook_manager.hookables[BaseSubject],
                           set(x for x in cast(Enum, TestEvents).__members__.values()))
        
        # Verify initial optimization flags are empty
        self.assertNotIn(HookFlag.CLASS, hook_manager.flags)
        self.assertNotIn(HookFlag.INSTANCE, hook_manager.flags)
        self.assertNotIn(HookFlag.ANY_EVENT, hook_manager.flags)
        self.assertNotIn(HookFlag.NAME, hook_manager.flags)
        
        # Setup callbacks
        cb1 = TestCallback(self, 'Alpha')
        cb2 = TestCallback(self, 'Beta')
        cb3 = TestCallback(self, 'Gamma')
        cb4 = TestCallback(self, 'Delta')
        
        # Add hooks
        hook_manager.add_hook(TestEvents.INIT, BaseSubject, cb1.trigger)
        self.assertIn(HookFlag.CLASS, hook_manager.flags)
        hook_manager.add_hook(TestEvents.INIT, BaseSubject, cb2.failing_trigger)
        hook_manager.add_hook(TestEvents.PERFORM, BaseSubject, cb3.trigger)
        hook_manager.add_hook(TestEvents.PERFORM, 'Target-X', cb4.trigger)
        self.assertIn(HookFlag.NAME, hook_manager.flags)
        
        # Verify hook registration
        key = (TestEvents.INIT, BaseSubject, ANY)
        self.assertTrue(key in hook_manager.hooks)
        self.assertIn(cb1.trigger, hook_manager.hooks[key].callbacks)
        self.assertIn(cb2.failing_trigger, hook_manager.hooks[key].callbacks)
        
        key = (TestEvents.PERFORM, BaseSubject, ANY)
        self.assertTrue(key in hook_manager.hooks)
        self.assertIn(cb3.trigger, hook_manager.hooks[key].callbacks)
        
        # Create instances (triggers INIT events)
        self.records.clear()
        instance_x = BaseSubject(self, 'Target-X', bind=True)
        self.assertEqual(self.records, [
            'Callback Alpha triggered for INIT from Target-X',
            'Target-X.INIT callback result: SUCCESS',
            'Callback Beta triggered for INIT from Target-X',
            'Target-X.INIT callback result: FAIL (Callback failure)'
        ])
        
        self.records.clear()

            'Callback Beta triggered for INIT from Target-Y',

        ])
        
        # Add instance-specific hooks
        hook_manager.add_hook(TestEvents.PERFORM, instance_x, cb1.trigger)

        hook_manager.add_hook(TestEvents.PERFORM, instance_y, cb2.trigger)
        
        # Verify instance hooks

        self.assertTrue(key in hook_manager.hooks)
        self.assertIn(cb1.trigger, hook_manager.hooks[key].callbacks)
        
        key = (TestEvents.PERFORM, ANY, instance_y)
        self.assertTrue(key in hook_manager.hooks)
        self.assertIn(cb2.trigger, hook_manager.hooks[key].callbacks)
        
        # Execute actions
        self.records.clear()
        instance_x.execute()
        self.assertEqual(self.records, [
            'Target-X.PERFORM!',
            'Callback Alpha triggered for PERFORM from Target-X',
            'Target-X.PERFORM callback result: SUCCESS',
            'Callback Delta triggered for PERFORM from Target-X',
            'Target-X.PERFORM callback result: SUCCESS',
            'Callback Gamma triggered for PERFORM from Target-X',

        self.records.clear()

            'Target-Y.PERFORM!',

        ])
        
        # Check optimization flags after hook additions

        self.assertIn(HookFlag.INSTANCE, hook_manager.flags)

        self.assertIn(HookFlag.NAME, hook_manager.flags)
        
        # Remove specific hooks
        hook_manager.remove_hook(TestEvents.INIT, BaseSubject, cb1.trigger)

        hook_manager.remove_hook(TestEvents.INIT, BaseSubject, cb2.failing_trigger)

import argparse
import os
import tarfile
import math
import random
import numpy as np
import pickle
import json

# Argument parsing setup
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Preprocess all tar.gz-ed files into training format')
parser.add_argument('--r', dest='root_dir', help='Directory containing all tar.gz files')
parser.add_argument('--a', dest='asset_dir', help='Directory to store processed files')

def extract_model_id(filename):
    """Extract model ID from tar.gz filename"""
    parts = filename.split('.')
    return parts[-3].split('/')[-1]

def process_tarball(filepath):
    """Extract tar.gz file if valid"""
    if filepath.endswith("tar.gz"):
        try:
            with tarfile.open(filepath, 'r:gz') as tar:
                tar.extractall()
            model_id = extract_model_id(filepath)
            print(f"Extracted model tar ball {model_id}")
            return model_id
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error extracting {filepath}: {e}")
    else:
        print(f"Not extracting file: {filepath}")
    return None

def load_unprocessed_ids(filepath):
    """Load unprocessed model IDs from text file"""
    ids = []
    try:
        with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
            for line in f:
                stripped = line.strip()
                if stripped:
                    ids.append(stripped)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print(f"Warning: {filepath} not found")
    return ids

def split_data(models, ratios):
    """Split models into train/val/test sets based on ratios"""
    total = len(models)
    counts = {
        'train': int(math.ceil(ratios['train'] * total)),
        'val': int(math.floor(ratios['val'] * total))
    }
    counts['test'] = total - counts['train'] - counts['val']
    
    shuffled = models.copy()
    random.shuffle(shuffled)
    
    train_end = counts['train']
    val_end = train_end + counts['val']
    
    return {
        'train': shuffled[:train_end],
        'val': shuffled[train_end:val_end],
        'test': shuffled[val_end:]
    }

def save_numpy_array(data, directory, filename):
    """Save numpy array to specified location"""
    path = os.path.join(directory, filename)
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        np.save(f, data)
    return filename

def process_single_images(root, assets, splits, chunk_size):
    """Process single image files and save metadata"""
    results = {}
    
    for split_name in ['train', 'val', 'test']:
        filenames = []
        file_list = []
        counter = 0
        chunk_index = 0
        
        for model_id in splits[split_name]:
            rgb_path = os.path.join(root, model_id, 'rgb')
            if not os.path.exists(rgb_path):
                continue
                
            for img_file in os.listdir(rgb_path):
                parts = img_file.split('_')
                point_id = parts[1]
                view_id = parts[3]
                rel_path = os.path.join(model_id, point_id, view_id)
                filenames.append(rel_path)
                counter += 1
                
                if counter % chunk_size == 0:
                    fname = f"{split_name}_image_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
                    file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
                    filenames.clear()
                    chunk_index += 1
        
        # Save remaining files
        if filenames:
            fname = f"{split_name}_image_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
            file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
        
        info = {'total_size': counter, 'filename_list': file_list}
        info_path = os.path.join(assets, f"{split_name}_split_image_info.pkl")
        with open(info_path, 'wb') as f:
            pickle.dump(info, f)
    
    return results

def get_view_pairs_from_json(json_path):
    """Extract view pairs from JSON file"""
    try:
        with open(json_path) as fp:
            data = json.load(fp)
            views = data.get('views', [])
            length = len(views)
            
            pairs = []
            for i in range(length):
                for j in range(i+1, length):
                    first = views[i]
                    second = views[j]
                    pair_str = f"{first['point_uuid']},{second['point_uuid']}/{first['view_id']},{second['view_id']}"
                    pairs.append(pair_str)
            return pairs
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error processing {json_path}: {e}")
        return []

def process_nonfixated_pairs(root, assets, splits, chunk_size):
    """Process non-fixated view pairs"""
    results = {}
    
    for split_name in ['train', 'val', 'test']:
        filenames = []
        file_list = []
        counter = 0
        chunk_index = 0
        
        for model_id in splits[split_name]:
            nonfix_path = os.path.join(root, model_id, 'nonfixated')
            if not os.path.exists(nonfix_path):
                continue
                
            for json_file in os.listdir(nonfix_path):
                full_path = os.path.join(nonfix_path, json_file)
                pairs = get_view_pairs_from_json(full_path)
                
                for pair in pairs:
                    rel_path = os.path.join(model_id, pair)
                    filenames.append(rel_path)
                    counter += 1
                    
                    if counter % chunk_size == 0:
                        fname = f"{split_name}_camera_nonfixated_pairs_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
                        file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
                        filenames.clear()
                        chunk_index += 1
        
        # Save remaining
        if filenames:
            fname = f"{split_name}_camera_nonfixated_pairs_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
            file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
        
        info = {'total_size': counter, 'filename_list': file_list}
        info_path = os.path.join(assets, f"{split_name}_camera_nonfixated_pairs_info.pkl")
        with open(info_path, 'wb') as f:
            pickle.dump(info, f)
    
    return results

def process_nonfixated_triplets(root, assets, splits, chunk_size):
    """Process non-fixated view triplets"""
    results = {}
    
    for split_name in ['train', 'val', 'test']:
        filenames = []
        file_list = []
        counter = 0
        chunk_index = 0
        
        for model_id in splits[split_name]:
            nonfix_path = os.path.join(root, model_id, 'nonfixated')
            if not os.path.exists(nonfix_path):
                continue
                
            for json_file in os.listdir(nonfix_path):
                full_path = os.path.join(nonfix_path, json_file)
                try:
                    with open(full_path) as fp:
                        data = json.load(fp)
                        views = data.get('views', [])
                        length = len(views)
                        
                        for i in range(length):
                            for j in range(i+1, length):
                                for k in range(j+1, length):
                                    v1, v2, v3 = views[i], views[j], views[k]
                                    trip_str = f"{v1['point_uuid']},{v2['point_uuid']},{v3['point_uuid']}/{v1['view_id']},{v2['view_id']},{v3['view_id']}"
                                    rel_path = os.path.join(model_id, trip_str)
                                    filenames.append(rel_path)
                                    counter += 1
                                    
                                    if counter % chunk_size == 0:
                                        fname = f"{split_name}_camera_nonfixated_triplets_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
                                        file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
                                        filenames.clear()
                                        chunk_index += 1
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Error processing {full_path}: {e}")
        
        # Save remaining
        if filenames:
            fname = f"{split_name}_camera_nonfixated_triplets_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
            file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
        
        info = {'total_size': counter, 'filename_list': file_list}
        info_path = os.path.join(assets, f"{split_name}_camera_nonfixated_triplets_info.pkl")
        with open(info_path, 'wb') as f:
            pickle.dump(info, f)
    
    return results

def count_views_per_point(root, model_id):
    """Count number of views per point ID"""
    points_count = {}
    points_path = os.path.join(root, model_id, 'points')
    
    if not os.path.exists(points_path):
        return points_count
    
    for file in os.listdir(points_path):
        parts = file.split('_')
        point_id = parts[1]
        points_count[point_id] = points_count.get(point_id, 0) + 1
    
    return points_count

def process_fixated_pairs(root, assets, splits, chunk_size):
    """Process fixated view pairs"""
    results = {}
    
    for split_name in ['train', 'val', 'test']:
        filenames = []
        file_list = []
        counter = 0
        chunk_index = 0
        
        for model_id in splits[split_name]:
            points_count = count_views_per_point(root, model_id)
            
            for point_id, count in points_count.items():
                for i in range(count):
                    for j in range(i+1, count):
                        rel_path = os.path.join(model_id, f"{point_id}/{i},{j}")
                        filenames.append(rel_path)
                        counter += 1
                        
                        if counter % chunk_size == 0:
                            fname = f"{split_name}_camera_fixated_pairs_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
                            file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
                            filenames.clear()
                            chunk_index += 1
        
        # Save remaining
        if filenames:
            fname = f"{split_name}_camera_fixated_pairs_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
            file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
        
        info = {'total_size': counter, 'filename_list': file_list}
        info_path = os.path.join(assets, f"{split_name}_camera_fixated_pairs_info.pkl")
        with open(info_path, 'wb') as f:
            pickle.dump(info, f)
    
    return results

def process_fixated_triplets(root, assets, splits, chunk_size):
    """Process fixated view triplets"""
    results = {}
    
    for split_name in ['train', 'val', 'test']:
        filenames = []
        file_list = []
        counter = 0
        chunk_index = 0
        
        for model_id in splits[split_name]:
            points_count = count_views_per_point(root, model_id)
            
            for point_id, count in points_count.items():
                for i in range(count):
                    for j in range(i+1, count):
                        for k in range(j+1, count):
                            rel_path = os.path.join(model_id, f"{point_id}/{i},{j},{k}")
                            filenames.append(rel_path)
                            counter += 1
                            
                            if counter % chunk_size == 0:
                                fname = f"{split_name}_camera_fixated_triplets_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
                                file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
                                filenames.clear()
                                chunk_index += 1
        
        # Save remaining
        if filenames:
            fname = f"{split_name}_camera_fixated_triplets_split_{chunk_index}.npy"
            file_list.append(save_numpy_array(np.array(filenames), assets, fname))
        
        info = {'total_size': counter, 'filename_list': file_list}
        info_path = os.path.join(assets, f"{split_name}_camera_fixated_triplets_info.pkl")
        with open(info_path, 'wb') as f:
            pickle.dump(info, f)
    
    return results

def main(_):
    print("Starting Preprocessing....")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    root_dir = args.root_dir
    asset_dir = args.asset_dir
    
    print(f"Extracting and Processing all tar.gz file located at {root_dir}")
    os.chdir(root_dir)
    print(f"Changing into directory: {root_dir}")
    
    # Load unprocessed model IDs
    meta_path = "meta/unprocessed_ids.txt"
    all_models = load_unprocessed_ids(meta_path)
    print(f"Finished loading {len(all_models)} models")
    
    # Split data
    ratios = {'train': 0.805, 'val': 0.128, 'test': 0.067}  # Adjusted to sum to ~1.0
    model_splits = split_data(all_models, ratios)
    
    print(f"train:val:test split has ratio: {ratios['train']},{ratios['val']},{ratios['test']}; "
          f"with count {len(model_splits['train'])},{len(model_splits['val'])},{len(model_splits['test'])}")
    
    # Save model splits
    model_info_path = os.path.join(asset_dir, 'all_models.pkl')
    with open(model_info_path, 'wb') as f:
        pickle.dump(model_splits, f)
    
    unit_size = 20000000
    
    # Process different data types
    process_single_images(root_dir, asset_dir, model_splits, unit_size)
    print("Done with Single Images...")
    
    process_nonfixated_pairs(root_dir, asset_dir, model_splits, unit_size)
    print("Done with Nonfixated Pairs...")
    
    process_nonfixated_triplets(root_dir, asset_dir, model_splits, unit_size)
    print("Done with Nonfixated Triplets...")
    
    process_fixated_pairs(root_dir, asset_dir, model_splits, unit_size)

import argparse
import io
import unicodedata
from PIL import Image

# Parse command line arguments for text normalization
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Normalize all ground truth texts for the given text files.')
parser.add_argument("filename", help="filename of text file", nargs='*')
parser.add_argument("-n", "--dry-run", help="display which files would be normalized without modifying them", action="store_true")
parser.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", help="print information about skipped files", action="store_true")
parser.add_argument("-f", "--form", help="Unicode normalization form (default: NFC)", 
                    choices=["NFC", "NFKC", "NFD", "NFKD"], default="NFC")
params = parser.parse_args()

# Process each specified file
for filepath in params.filename:
    try:
        with io.open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as input_file:
            original_content = input_file.read()
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        if params.verbose:
            print(f"{filepath} (skipped)")
        continue
    
    # Apply Unicode normalization
    normalized_content = unicodedata.normalize(params.form, original_content)
    
    # Check if normalization changed the content
    if original_content != normalized_content:
        print(filepath)
        if not params.dry_run:
            with io.open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output_file:
                output_file.write(normalized_content)

import pytest
import mars.oscar as mo
from mars.services import start_services, NodeRole
from mars.services.session.api import SessionAPI
from mars.services.meta.api import MetaAPI

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_meta_service():
    # Create a local actor pool with no processes
    pool = await mo.create_actor_pool('127.0.0.1', n_process=0)
    
    async with pool:
        # Configure services to start
        service_config = {
            "services": ["cluster", "session", "meta"],
            "cluster": {
                "backend": "fixed",
                "lookup_address": pool.external_address,
            },
            "meta": {
                "store": "dict"
            }
        }
        
        # Start supervisor services
        await start_services(
            NodeRole.SUPERVISOR, service_config, address=pool.external_address)
        
        # Create a test session
        test_session_id = 'test_session'
        session_api_instance = await SessionAPI.create(pool.external_address)
        await session_api_instance.create_session(test_session_id)
        
        # Access the meta API for the created session
        meta_api_ref = await MetaAPI.create(test_session_id, pool.external_address)
        
        # First destruction should succeed
        await MetaAPI.destroy_session(test_session_id, pool.external_address)
        
        # Second destruction should raise ActorNotExist exception
        with pytest.raises(mo.ActorNotExist):
            await MetaAPI.destroy_session(test_session_id, pool.external_address)
        
        # Verify alru_cache behavior: creating again should return same reference
        assert await MetaAPI.create(test_session_id, pool.external_address) is meta_api_ref

import os
import sys
import torch
import torch.multiprocessing as mp
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple, Any
from main.data_loading import make_disk_dataloaders, make_navigation_dataloaders, make_perception_dataloaders
from main.train_loop import train_eval_loop
from lgp.utils.better_summary_writer import BetterSummaryWriter
from lgp.parameters import Hyperparams, load_experiment_definition
from lgp import model_registry
from lgp import paths


def _ensure_directory(dir_path: str) -> str:
    """Ensure directory exists and return the path."""
    os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)
    return dir_path


def _construct_full_path(directory: str, filename: str) -> str:
    """Construct full file path from directory and filename."""
    return os.path.join(directory, filename)


def get_model_filepath(filename: str) -> str:
    """Get full path for model file."""
    models_dir = _ensure_directory(paths.get_model_dir())
    return _construct_full_path(models_dir, filename)


def get_checkpoint_filepath(filename: str) -> str:
    """Get full path for checkpoint file."""
    checkpoints_dir = _ensure_directory(paths.get_checkpoint_dir())
    return _construct_full_path(checkpoints_dir, filename)


def persist_checkpoint(
    neural_net,
    optimizer_pair,
    model_name: str,
    checkpoint_name: str,
    current_epoch: int,
    global_step: int
):
    """Save model and optimizer states to disk."""
    # Save model state dictionaries
    model_state = neural_net.state_dict()
    last_model_path = f"{model_name}.pytorch"
    epoch_model_path = f"{model_name}_e{current_epoch}.pytorch"
    
    torch.save(model_state, get_model_filepath(last_model_path))
    torch.save(model_state, get_model_filepath(epoch_model_path))
    print(f"Model saved at: {epoch_model_path} and {last_model_path}")
    
    # Prepare optimizer states for saving
    non_bert_optim_state = optimizer_pair[0].state_dict() if optimizer_pair[0] else None
    bert_optim_state = optimizer_pair[1].state_dict() if optimizer_pair[1] is not None else None
    
    checkpoint_data = {
        "nonbert_optimizer": non_bert_optim_state,
        "bert_optimizer": bert_optim_state,
        "epoch": current_epoch,
        "iter": global_step
    }
    
    # Save checkpoint data redundantly for robustness
    primary_checkpoint_path = get_checkpoint_filepath(checkpoint_name)
    backup_checkpoint_path = get_checkpoint_filepath(f"{checkpoint_name}_b")
    
    torch.save(checkpoint_data, primary_checkpoint_path)
    torch.save(checkpoint_data, backup_checkpoint_path)
    print(f"Checkpoint saved at: {checkpoint_name} and {checkpoint_name}_b")


def restore_checkpoint(checkpoint_file: str, model_file: str):
    """Load model and optimizer states from disk."""
    model_state = torch.load(model_file)
    checkpoint_data = torch.load(checkpoint_file)
    
    non_bert_optim_state = checkpoint_data["nonbert_optimizer"]
    bert_optim_state = checkpoint_data["bert_optimizer"]
    loaded_epoch = checkpoint_data["epoch"]
    loaded_iter = checkpoint_data["iter"]
    
    optimizer_states = (non_bert_optim_state, bert_optim_state)
    return optimizer_states, model_state, loaded_epoch, loaded_iter


def execute_training_pipeline(experiment_config: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Main training orchestration function."""
    # Extract configuration sections
    setup_section = experiment_config.get("Setup", {})
    environment_type = setup_section.get("env")
    env_configuration = setup_section.get("env_setup")
    target_device = torch.device(setup_section.get("device", "cpu"))
    experiment_identifier = setup_section.get("experiment_name")
    max_trajectories = setup_section.get("max_rollouts")
    pretrained_model_path = setup_section.get("load_model_file")
    output_model_name = setup_section.get("save_model_file")
    output_checkpoint_name = setup_section.get("save_checkpoint_file")
    input_checkpoint_path = setup_section.get("load_checkpoint_file")
    total_epochs = setup_section.get("num_epochs")
    network_architecture = setup_section.get("model_type")
    samples_per_batch = setup_section.get("batch_size", 1)
    dataset_category = setup_section.get("dataset_type", "subgoals")
    data_workers = setup_section.get("num_workers", 0)
    
    # Initialize hyperparameters
    hp = Hyperparams(experiment_config.get("Hyperparams", {}))
    
    # Load appropriate datasets based on category
    print("Initializing data loaders...")
    if dataset_category == "subgoals":
        training_loader, validation_loader = make_disk_dataloaders(
            "tapm", env_configuration, max_trajectories, environment_type, hp, 
            samples_per_batch, data_workers
        )
    elif dataset_category == "navigation":
        training_loader, validation_loader = make_navigation_dataloaders(
            env_configuration, max_trajectories, samples_per_batch, data_workers
        )
    elif dataset_category == "perception":
        training_loader, validation_loader = make_perception_dataloaders(
            env_configuration, max_trajectories, samples_per_batch, data_workers
        )
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported dataset type: {dataset_category}")
    
    # Setup logging
    log_writer = BetterSummaryWriter(
        paths.get_experiment_runs_dir(experiment_identifier), 
        start_iter=0
    )
    
    # Build model
    print(f"Constructing model: {network_architecture}")
    model_instance = model_registry.get_model(network_architecture)(hp)
    total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model_instance.parameters())
    print(f"Total parameters in model: {total_params}")
    
    # Handle checkpoint/model loading
    optimizer_pair = None
    optimizer_state_dicts = None
    starting_epoch = 0
    global_step_counter = 0
    
    if input_checkpoint_path is not None:
        print(f"Restoring from checkpoint: {input_checkpoint_path}, using model: {pretrained_model_path}")
        optimizer_state_dicts, model_state_dict, starting_epoch, global_step_counter = \
            restore_checkpoint(input_checkpoint_path, pretrained_model_path)
        model_instance.load_state_dict(model_state_dict)
    else:
        if pretrained_model_path is not None:
            print(f"Loading initial model weights from: {pretrained_model_path}")
            model_instance.load_state_dict(torch.load(pretrained_model_path))
    
    # Move model to target device
    model_instance = model_instance.to(target_device)
    
    # Training loop
    for current_epoch in range(starting_epoch, total_epochs):
        global_step_counter, optimizer_pair = train_eval_loop(
            training_loader,
            model_instance,
            log_writer,
            val=False,
            optimargs=hp.get("optimizer_args").d,
            gstep=global_step_counter,
            device=target_device,
            optimizers=optimizer_pair,
            optimizer_states=optimizer_state_dicts
        )
        
        # Run validation
        train_eval_loop(
            validation_loader,
            model_instance,
            log_writer,
            val=True,
            optimargs=hp.get("optimizer_args").d,
            device=target_device
        )
        
        # Save checkpoint after each epoch
        persist_checkpoint(
            model_instance,
            optimizer_pair,
            output_model_name,
            output_checkpoint_name,
            current_epoch,
            global_step_counter
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    mp.set_start_method("spawn")
    
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python script.py <experiment_definition>")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    config_file = sys.argv[1]
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    
    experiment_definition = load_experiment_definition(config_file)
    execute_training_pipeline(experiment_definition)

    are_tao_frames_dumped, dump_tao_frames, remove_non_tao_frames)

# Metadata directory relative to this script
META_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'meta'

# AVA dataset base URL for downloading videos
AVA_URL = 'https://s3.amazonaws.com/ava-dataset'


def release_video_resources(video_clip):
    """Safely close video and audio readers of a VideoFileClip."""
    if video_clip.reader:
        video_clip.reader.close()
    if video_clip.audio and video_clip.audio.reader:
        video_clip.audio.reader.close_proc()


def load_ava_metadata():
    """Load AVA metadata from local files."""
    metadata = {}
    for split in ('trainval', 'test'):
        meta_file = META_DIR / f'ava_file_names_{split}_v2.1.txt'
        with open(meta_file, 'r') as f:
            for line in f:
                stem, ext = line.strip().rsplit('.', 1)
                metadata[stem] = {'ext': ext, 'split': split}
    return metadata


def fetch_ava_videos(root_dir,
                     annotations_data,
                     frame_checksums,
                     num_workers=8,
                     local_movies_dir=None):
    # Set up directories for caching and output
    if local_movies_dir is None:
        local_movies_dir = root_dir / 'cache' / 'ava_movies'
        local_movies_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    logging.info('Downloading AVA videos.')
    
    # Filter only AVA videos from the annotation data
    ava_videos = [
        v for v in annotations_data['videos'] 
        if v['metadata']['dataset'] == 'AVA'
    ]

    # Group clips by movie name
    movie_to_clips = defaultdict(list)
    for clip in ava_videos:
        movie_to_clips[clip['metadata']['movie']].append(clip)

    # Load AVA metadata (file extensions and splits)
    ava_meta = load_ava_metadata()

    videos_output_dir = root_dir / 'videos'
    frames_output_dir = root_dir / 'frames'

    for movie_name, clips_list in tqdm(movie_to_clips.items(),
                                       desc='Processing AVA movies'):
        # Construct full movie filename
        ext = ava_meta[movie_name]['ext']
        full_movie_name = f"{movie_name}.{ext}"

        # Prepare list of clips that still need processing
        pending_clips = []
        for clip in clips_list:
            clip_name = clip['name']
            clip_path = file_path(videos_output_dir / f"{clip_name}.mp4")
            frames_path = dir_path(frames_output_dir / clip_name)

            # Skip if frames already exist and checksum matches
            if are_tao_frames_dumped(frames_path, frame_checksums[clip_name], warn=False):
                logging.debug(f'Skipping already extracted clip: {clip_name}')
                continue

            pending_clips.append((clip, clip_path, frames_path))

        # Download movie if any clips need it
        if not all(p[1].exists() for p in pending_clips):
            downloaded_this_session = False
            cached_movie_path = local_movies_dir / full_movie_name

            # Check if movie exists locally (either pre-existing or just downloaded)
            if local_movies_dir and cached_movie_path.exists():
                logging.debug(f'Using existing AVA movie: {full_movie_name}')
            else:
                downloaded_this_session = True
                url = f"{AVA_URL}/{ava_meta[movie_name]['split']}/{full_movie_name}"
                logging.debug(f'Downloading AVA movie: {full_movie_name} from {url}')
                urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, cached_movie_path)

            # Load the full movie into memory
            full_movie_clip = VideoFileClip(str(cached_movie_path))
        else:
            full_movie_clip = None

        # Process each pending clip
        for clip_info, clip_out_path, frames_dir in tqdm(
                pending_clips, desc='Extracting shots', leave=False):

            if clip_out_path.exists():
                continue

            # Parse start/end timestamps from scene metadata
            shot_range = clip_info['metadata']['scene'].rsplit('_', 1)[1]
            start_sec, end_sec = map(int, shot_range.split('-'))

            # Extract subclip using time in seconds
            subclip = full_movie_clip.subclip(
                start_sec / full_movie_clip.fps,
                end_sec / full_movie_clip.fps
            )

            # Write subclip to disk
            subclip.write_videofile(str(clip_out_path),
                                    audio=False,
                                    verbose=False,
                                    progress_bar=False)
            release_video_resources(subclip)

        # Clean up full movie resources if we loaded it
        if full_movie_clip:
            release_video_resources(full_movie_clip)
            if downloaded_this_session and cached_movie_path.exists():
                cached_movie_path.unlink()

        # Dump TAO frames for remaining clips
        logging.debug(
            f'AVA: Dumping TAO frames:\n{[(p[1], p[2]) for p in pending_clips]}')
        dump_tao_frames([p[1] for p in pending_clips],
                        [p[2] for p in pending_clips],
                        num_workers)

        # Validate and clean up non-TAO frames
        for clip, clip_path, frame_dir in pending_clips:
            clip_name = clip['name']
            if not are_tao_frames_dumped(frame_dir, frame_checksums[clip_name]):
                raise ValueError(
                    f'Incomplete frame extraction for {clip_name}. '
                    f'Please delete {clip_path} and re-run.')

            remove_non_tao_frames(frame_dir,
                                  set(frame_checksums[clip_name].keys()))

            assert are_tao_frames_dumped(frame_dir, frame_checksums[clip_name]), (
                f'ERROR: Frames for {clip_name} were corrupted during cleanup. '
                f'This indicates a bug — please report it.')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=__doc__.split('\n')[0] if __doc__ else '',
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter)

from sandcraft.particle import Particle
from sandcraft import particle_data
from random import random

class Fixed(Particle):
    def __init__(
            self,
            col, row,
            vel_x, vel_y,
            acc_x, acc_y,
            temp, temp_freeze, temp_boil,
            density,
            color,
            name,
            flammability,
            state):
        super().__init__(
            col, row,
            vel_x, vel_y,
            acc_x, acc_y,
            temp, temp_freeze, temp_boil,
            density,
            color,
            name,
            flammability,
            state)
    
    def clone(self, col, row):
        return Fixed(
            col, row,
            self._vel_x, self._vel_y,
            self._acc_x, self._acc_y,
            self._temp, self._temp_freeze, self._temp_boil,
            self._density,
            self._color,
            self._name,
            self._flammability,
            self._state)
    
    def update_on_tick(self, driver, grid):
        # Handle special particle behaviors
        if self._name == "Water Generator":
            target_pos = (self._col + 1, self._row)
            if not grid.exists(target_pos):
                driver.add(particle_data.template_water.clone(*target_pos))
        
        elif self._name == "bush":
            # Attempt upward growth
            if random() < 0.003 and self._row > 6:
                pos_up = (self._col, self._row - 1)
                if not grid.exists(pos_up):
                    driver.add(particle_data.template_bush.clone(*pos_up))
            
            # Attempt horizontal growth (right)
            if random() < 0.001:
                pos_right = (self._col + 1, self._row)
                if not grid.exists(pos_right):
                    driver.add(particle_data.template_bush.clone(*pos_right))
            
            # Attempt horizontal growth (left)
            if random() < 0.001:
                pos_left = (self._col - 1, self._row)
                if not grid.exists(pos_left):
                    driver.add(particle_data.template_bush.clone(*pos_left))
        
        elif self._name == "vine":
            # Vertical growth for vines
            if random() < 0.03 and self._row > 6:
                pos_up = (self._col, self._row - 1)
                if not grid.exists(pos_up):
                    driver.add(particle_data.template_vine.clone(*pos_up))
            
            # Horizontal growth every 7 rows
            if self._row % 7 == 0:
                if random() < 0.001:
                    pos_right = (self._col + 1, self._row)
                    if not grid.exists(pos_right):
                        driver.add(particle_data.template_vine.clone(*pos_right))
                
                if random() < 0.001:
                    pos_left = (self._col - 1, self._row)
                    if not grid.exists(pos_left):
                        driver.add(particle_data.template_vine.clone(*pos_left))
        
        # Skip further processing if no update needed
        if not self._needs_update:
            return
        
        # Heat exchange with neighboring particles
        neighbors = grid.get_near((self._col, self._row))
        for neighbor in neighbors:
            temp_diff = (self._temp - neighbor.temp) / 50.0
            neighbor.update_temp(neighbor.temp + temp_diff)
            self.update_temp(self._temp - temp_diff)
        
        # Phase transitions based on temperature
        # Boiling: solid -> gas
        if self._temp >= self._temp_boil:
            self.boil(driver, grid, particle_data.template_steam.clone(self._col, self._row))
        
        # Melting of ice to water
        if self._name == "ice" and self._temp >= self._temp_freeze:
            saved_temp = self._temp
            self.melt(driver, grid, particle_data.template_water.clone(self._col, self._row))
            self.update_temp(saved_temp)
        
        # Melting of basalt/metal to lava
        if self._name in ("basalt", "metal") and self._temp >= self._temp_freeze:
            saved_temp = self._temp
            self.melt(driver, grid, particle_data.template_lava.clone(self._col, self._row))
            self.update_temp(saved_temp)
        
        # Wood burning
        if self._name == "wood" and self._temp >= self._temp_freeze:
            saved_temp = self._temp
            self.melt(driver, grid, particle_data.template_fire.clone(self._col, self._row))
            self.update_temp(saved_temp)
        
        # Metal melting (redundant condition but kept for compatibility)
        if self._name == "metal" and self._temp >= self._temp_freeze:
            saved_temp = self._temp
            self.melt(driver, grid, particle_data.template_lava.clone(self._col, self._row))
            self.update_temp(saved_temp)
        
        # Reset update flag
        self._needs_update = False

import os
from typing import NamedTuple, Dict, Any, Optional
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pickle
from sklearn import metrics
import xgboost as xgb
import importlib.util
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)

# Dynamically load model base class
base_module_name = "model_template"
base_file_path = os.path.join(
    os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))),
    f"{base_module_name}.py"
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(base_module_name, base_file_path)
base_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(base_module)
data_preparation = base_module.data_preparation


class EvaluationResult(NamedTuple):
    mse: float


class RegressorWrapper:
    """Wrapper class encapsulating XGBoost regressor with additional utilities."""

    DEFAULT_HYPERPARAMS = {
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "n_estimators": 40,
        "max_depth": 10
    }

    def __init__(self, estimator=None):
        self.estimator = estimator

    def _instantiate_estimator(self, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> None:
        """Initialize the underlying regressor."""
        if self.estimator is None:
            if params is None:
                self.estimator = xgb.XGBRegressor(objective='reg:squarederror')
            else:
                self.estimator = xgb.XGBRegressor(
                    objective='reg:squarederror',
                    **{k: v for k, v in params.items() if k != 'objective'}
                )

    def fit(self, features: pd.DataFrame, target: pd.Series) -> None:
        """Train the model on given data."""
        if self.estimator is None:
            self._instantiate_estimator()
        self.estimator.fit(features, target)

    def infer(self, features: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        """Generate predictions from trained model."""
        if self.estimator is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Model has not been trained yet.")
        try:
            return self.estimator.predict(features)
        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Prediction failed: {e}")

    def assess(self, actual: pd.Series, predicted: np.ndarray) -> EvaluationResult:
        """Compute evaluation metric(s)."""
        mse_val = metrics.mean_squared_error(actual, predicted)
        return EvaluationResult(mse=mse_val)

    def optimize_hyperparams(self,
                             features: pd.DataFrame,
                             target: pd.Series,
                             param_grid: Dict[str, list]) -> EvaluationResult:
        """Perform exhaustive search over specified parameter values using cross-validation."""
        if self.estimator is None:
            self._instantiate_estimator(params={})

        best_score = float('inf')
        best_params = None

        # Manual grid search implementation (equivalent to GridSearchCV with cv=2)
        param_keys = list(param_grid.keys())
        param_values = [param_grid[k] for k in param_keys]

        from itertools import product
        for combo in product(*param_values):
            current_params = dict(zip(param_keys, combo))
            temp_model = xgb.XGBRegressor(
                objective='reg:squarederror',
                **current_params
            )
            # Simple train/validation split (2-fold CV approximated)
            n = len(target)
            mid = n // 2
            idx_train = list(range(mid)) + list(range(mid + 1, n))
            idx_val = [mid]
            
            X_tr, y_tr = features.iloc[idx_train], target.iloc[idx_train]
            X_vl, y_vl = features.iloc[idx_val], target.iloc[idx_val]

            temp_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
            preds = temp_model.predict(X_vl)
            score = metrics.mean_squared_error(y_vl, preds)

            if score < best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_params = current_params.copy()

        # Retrain final model with best params on full data
        self._instantiate_estimator(best_params)
        self.fit(features, target)

        # Evaluate on full dataset
        preds_full = self.infer(features)
        return self.assess(target, preds_full)

    def serialize(self, directory: str) -> None:
        """Persist model to disk."""
        try:
            os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
            model_path = os.path.join(directory, 'model.pkl')
            with open(model_path, 'wb') as fh:
                pickle.dump(self.estimator, fh)
        except Exception as err:
            raise IOError(f"Failed to save model: {err}")

    def deserialize(self, filepath: str) -> None:
        """Restore model from disk."""
        try:
            with open(filepath, 'rb') as fh:
                self.estimator = pickle.load(fh)
        except Exception as err:
            raise IOError(f"Failed to load model: {err}")


class Model(RegressorWrapper, base_module.Model):
    """Concrete implementation of the abstract model interface."""

    def train(self,
              X: pd.DataFrame,
              y: pd.Series) -> EvaluationResult:
        """Train the model and compute performance on training set."""
        self.fit(X, y)
        y_hat = self.infer(X)
        return self.assess(y, y_hat)

    def grid_search(self,
                    X: pd.DataFrame,
                    y: pd.Series,
                    config: Dict[str, list]) -> EvaluationResult:
        """Run hyperparameter tuning and update internal estimator."""
        return self.optimize_hyperparams(X, y, config)

# Performance testing utilities for pytest

import collections
import contextlib
import cProfile
import datetime
import pathlib
import pytest
import time

# Store timing measurements
timing_data = collections.deque()

def pytest_addoption(parser):
    """Add command-line options for performance testing."""
    parser.addoption(
        "--benchmark",
        action="store_true",
        help="enable benchmark mode (run performance tests)"
    )

def pytest_configure(config):
    """Register custom marker for performance tests."""
    config.addinivalue_line(
        "markers", 
        "benchmark: mark test as a performance benchmark"
    )

def pytest_runtest_setup(item):
    """Skip tests based on benchmark mode configuration."""
    is_benchmark_mode = item.config.getoption("--benchmark")
    is_benchmark_test = any(item.iter_markers(name="benchmark"))
    
    if is_benchmark_mode and not is_benchmark_test:
        pytest.skip("skipping non-benchmark tests in benchmark mode")
    elif not is_benchmark_mode and is_benchmark_test:
        pytest.skip("skipping benchmark tests outside benchmark mode")

def pytest_terminal_summary(terminalreporter, exitstatus, config):
    """Output timing summary at end of test run."""
    if not timing_data:
        return
        
    terminalreporter.write("\nPerformance Timing Report:\n")
    for entry in timing_data:
        module_path = entry['module']
        class_name = entry.get('class', '')
        func_name = entry['function']
        desc = entry['description']
        elapsed = datetime.timedelta(seconds=entry['elapsed'])
        
        # Format identifier path
        parts = [module_path]
        if class_name:
            parts.append(class_name)
        parts.append(func_name)
        full_id = " :: ".join(parts)
        
        terminalreporter.write(f"> {elapsed} [{full_id}] {desc}\n")

@pytest.fixture
def timing(request):
    """Fixture to measure execution time of code blocks."""
    module_name = request.module.__name__
    class_name = request.cls.__name__ if request.cls else ""
    function_name = request.function.__name__
    
    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def timing_context(description=""):
        start_time = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            elapsed_time = time.perf_counter() - start_time
            timing_data.append({
                'module': module_name,
                'class': class_name,
                'function': function_name,
                'description': description,
                'elapsed': elapsed_time
            })
    
    return timing_context

@pytest.fixture
def profiler(request):
    """Fixture to profile code execution using cProfile."""
    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def profiling_context(name=None):

        if name:
