class JumpOptimalControlSetup:
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_instance: Jumper,
        num_phases: int,
        threads=8,
        ctrl_type=ControlType.CONSTANT,
    ):
        # Dimensions and mappings
        self.n_dof = self.n_qdot = self.n_tau = -1
        self.dof_maps = BiMappingList()
        
        # Lists for OCP components
        self.dyn_list = DynamicsList()
        self.cons_list = ConstraintList()
        self.obj_list = ObjectiveList()
        self.state_bounds = BoundsList()
        self.ctrl_bounds = BoundsList()
        self.trans_list = PhaseTransitionList()
        self.init_states = []
        self.state_guess = InitialGuessList()
        self.ctrl_guess = InitialGuessList()

        if not (1 <= num_phases <= 5):
            raise ValueError("Number of phases must be between 1 and 5 inclusive.")
        
        self.model = model_instance
        self.num_phases = num_phases
        self.takeoff_idx = 0 if self.num_phases == 1 else 1
        self.ctrl_type = ctrl_type
        self.ctrl_node_placement = Node.ALL if self.ctrl_type == ControlType.LINEAR_CONTINUOUS else Node.ALL_SHOOTING

        self._configure_dimensions_and_mappings()
        self._initialize_state_guesses()
        self._setup_dynamics()
        self._apply_constraints()
        self._define_objectives()
        self._enforce_boundary_conditions()
        self._link_phase_transitions()
        self._set_initial_guess_vectors()
        
        self.ocp = OptimalControlProgram(
            self.model.models[:self.num_phases],
            self.dyn_list,
            self.model.n_shoot[:self.num_phases],
            self.model.phase_time[:self.num_phases],
            x_init=self.state_guess,
            x_bounds=self.state_bounds,
            u_init=self.ctrl_guess,
            u_bounds=self.ctrl_bounds,
            objective_functions=self.obj_list,
            constraints=self.cons_list,
            variable_mappings=self.dof_maps,
            phase_transitions=self.trans_list,
            n_threads=threads,
            control_type=self.ctrl_type,
            ode_solver=self.model.ode_solver,
        )

    def _initialize_state_guesses(self):
        base_pose = np.array([self.model.body_at_first_node]).T
        init_vel = np.array([self.model.initial_velocity]).T
        root_dofs = self.model.models[0].nbRoot()
        base_pose[:root_dofs, 0] = self.model.find_initial_root_pose()
        self.init_states = np.vstack((base_pose, init_vel))

    def _configure_dimensions_and_mappings(self):
        q_map = self.model.q_mapping
        tau_map = self.model.tau_mapping
        
        self.dof_maps.add("q", q_map.to_second.map_idx, q_map.to_first.map_idx)
        self.dof_maps.add("qdot", q_map.to_second.map_idx, q_map.to_first.map_idx)
        self.dof_maps.add("tau", tau_map.to_second.map_idx, tau_map.to_first.map_idx)

        self.n_dof = len(self.dof_maps["q"].to_first)
        self.n_qdot = self.n_dof
        self.n_tau = len(self.dof_maps["tau"].to_first)

    def _setup_dynamics(self):
        # Define dynamics per phase based on contact configuration
        phase_configs = [
            (DynamicsFcn.TORQUE_DRIVEN, True),   # Takeoff: flat foot
            (DynamicsFcn.TORQUE_DRIVEN, True),   # Mid-air transition: toe only
            (DynamicsFcn.TORQUE_DRIVEN, False),  # Aerial phase
            (DynamicsFcn.TORQUE_DRIVEN, True),   # Landing prep: toe only
            (DynamicsFcn.TORQUE_DRIVEN, True),   # Final stance: flat foot
        ]
        for idx in range(self.num_phases):
            dyn_func, has_contact = phase_configs[idx]
            self.dyn_list.add(dyn_func, with_contact=has_contact)

    def _apply_constraints(self):
        # Torque limits enforced across all phases
        for idx in range(self.num_phases):
            self.cons_list.add(
                ConstraintFcn.TORQUE_MAX_FROM_Q_AND_QDOT,
                phase=idx,
                node=self.ctrl_node_placement,
                min_torque=self.model.tau_min
            )

        # Ensure upward motion before takeoff
        self.cons_list.add(
            com_dot_z,
            phase=self.takeoff_idx,
            node=Node.END,
            min_bound=0,
            max_bound=np.inf
        )

        # Flat-foot phase constraints
        for p in self.model.flat_foot_phases:
            if p >= self.num_phases:
                continue
            # Contact force bounds (no pull)
            for idx in self.model.flatfoot_contact_z_idx:
                self.cons_list.add(
                    ConstraintFcn.TRACK_CONTACT_FORCES,
                    phase=p,
                    node=self.ctrl_node_placement,
                    contact_index=idx,
                    max_bound=np.inf
                )
            # Non-slipping condition
            self.cons_list.add(
                ConstraintFcn.NON_SLIPPING,
                phase=p,
                node=self.ctrl_node_placement,
                tangential_component_idx=self.model.flatfoot_non_slipping[0],
                normal_component_idx=self.model.flatfoot_non_slipping[1],
                static_friction_coefficient=self.model.static_friction_coefficient,
            )

        # Toe-only phase constraints
        for p in self.model.toe_only_phases:
            if p >= self.num_phases:
                continue
            # Contact force bounds (no pull)
            for idx in self.model.toe_contact_z_idx:
                self.cons_list.add(
                    ConstraintFcn.TRACK_CONTACT_FORCES,
                    phase=p,
                    node=self.ctrl_node_placement,
                    contact_index=idx,
                    max_bound=np.inf
                )
            # Heel above floor
            self.cons_list.add(
                marker_on_floor,
                phase=p,
                node=Node.ALL,
                index=2,
                min_bound=-1e-4,
                max_bound=np.inf,
                marker=self.model.heel_marker_idx,
                target=self.model.floor_z,
            )
            # Non-slipping condition
            self.cons_list.add(
                ConstraintFcn.NON_SLIPPING,
                phase=p,
                node=self.ctrl_node_placement,
                tangential_component_idx=self.model.toe_non_slipping[0],
                normal_component_idx=self.model.toe_non_slipping[1],
                static_friction_coefficient=self.model.static_friction_coefficient,
            )

    def _define_objectives(self):
        # Maximize jump height (minimize negative height)
        self.obj_list.add(
            ObjectiveFcn.Mayer.MINIMIZE_PREDICTED_COM_HEIGHT,
            weight=-100,
            phase=self.takeoff_idx
        )

        # Minimize control effort on root DOFs
        for p in range(self.num_phases):
            root_indices = [
                i for i in self.model.tau_mapping.to_second.map_idx[:self.model.models[p].nbRoot()]
                if i is not None
            ]
            if root_indices:
                self.obj_list.add(
                    ObjectiveFcn.Lagrange.MINIMIZE_CONTROL,
                    key="tau",
                    weight=0.1,
                    phase=p,
                    index=root_indices,
                )

        # Smoothness penalties
        for p in range(self.num_phases):
            if self.ctrl_type == ControlType.LINEAR_CONTINUOUS:
                self.obj_list.add(
                    ObjectiveFcn.Lagrange.MINIMIZE_CONTROL,
                    key="tau",
                    weight=0.1,
                    derivative=True,
                    phase=p,
                )
        for p in range(2, self.num_phases):
            self.obj_list.add(
                ObjectiveFcn.Lagrange.MINIMIZE_STATE,
                key="qdot",
                weight=0.1,
                derivative=True,
                phase=p,
            )

        # Time minimization (if time bounds allow)
        for i in range(self.num_phases):
            if self.model.time_min[i] != self.model.time_max[i]:
                self.obj_list.add(
                    ObjectiveFcn.Mayer.MINIMIZE_TIME,
                    weight=0.1,
                    phase=i,
                    min_bound=self.model.time_min[i],
                    max_bound=self.model.time_max[i],
                )

    def _enforce_boundary_conditions(self):
        for i in range(self.num_phases):
            self.state_bounds.add(bounds=QAndQDotBounds(self.model.models[i], dof_mappings=self.dof_maps))
            if i in [3, 4]:  # Allow higher velocities at reception
                dof_idx = self.model.heel_dof + self.n_dof
                self.state_bounds[i].max[dof_idx, :] *= 2
            self.ctrl_bounds.add(
                [-self.model.tau_constant_bound] * self.n_tau,
                [self.model.tau_constant_bound] * self.n_tau
            )

        # Enforce initial state
        self.state_bounds[0][:, 0] = self.init_states[:, 0]

        # Final pose matching (excluding translation)
        if self.num_phases >= 4:
            final_model = self.model.models[self.num_phases - 1]
            trans_dof_count = final_model.segment(0).nbDofTrans()
            target_state = self.init_states[trans_dof_count:self.n_dof, :]
            target_qdot = self.init_states[self.n_dof:, :]

            self.cons_list.add(
                ConstraintFcn.TRACK_STATE,
                key="q",
                node=Node.END,
                phase=self.num_phases - 1,
                index=range(trans_dof_count, self.n_dof),
                target=target_state,
                min_bound=-0.1,
                max_bound=0.1,
            )
            self.cons_list.add(
                ConstraintFcn.TRACK_STATE,
                key="qdot",
                node=Node.END,
                phase=self.num_phases - 1,
                target=target_qdot,
                min_bound=-0.1,
                max_bound=0.1,
            )

    def _set_initial_guess_vectors(self):
        for _ in range(self.num_phases):
            self.state_guess.add(self.init_states)
            self.ctrl_guess.add([0.0] * self.n_tau)

    def _link_phase_transitions(self):
        # Add transitions between phases
        if self.num_phases >= 2:
            self.trans_list.add(PhaseTransitionFcn.CONTINUOUS, phase_pre_idx=0)
        if self.num_phases >= 3:
            self.trans_list.add(PhaseTransitionFcn.CONTINUOUS, phase_pre_idx=1)
        if self.num_phases >= 4:
            self.trans_list.add(PhaseTransitionFcn.IMPACT, phase_pre_idx=2)
        if self.num_phases >= 5:
            self.trans_list.add(PhaseTransitionFcn.IMPACT, phase_pre_idx=3)

        # Additional constraints for specific phase boundaries
        if self.num_phases >= 3:
            self.cons_list.add(
                marker_on_floor,
                phase=2,
                index=2,
                node=Node.END,
                min_bound=-1e-3,
                max_bound=1e-3,
                marker=self.model.toe_marker_idx,
                target=self.model.floor_z,
            )
        if self.num_phases >= 4:
            self.cons_list.add(
                marker_on_floor,
                phase=3,
                index=2,
                node=Node.END,
                min_bound=-1e-3,
                max_bound=1e-3,
                marker=self.model.heel_marker_idx,
                target=self.model.floor_z,
            )

        # Relax velocity bounds during reception phases
        if self.num_phases >= 4:
            idx = self.n_dof
            self.state_bounds[3].min[idx:, 0] *= 2
            self.state_bounds[3].max[idx:, 0] *= 2
        if self.num_phases >= 5:
            idx = self.n_dof
            self.state_bounds[4].min[idx:, 0] *= 2
            self.state_bounds[4].max[idx:, 0] *= 2

    def solve(
        self,
        lm_max_iter,
        ex_max_iter,
        load_path=None,
        disable_plot=False,
        solver_backend="mumps"
    ):
        if not disable_plot:
            add_custom_plots(self.ocp, self)

        if load_path:
            _, solution = OptimalControlProgram.load(load_path)
            return solution

        solver = Solver.IPOPT()
        solver.set_linear_solver(solver_backend)
        solver.set_print_level(0)

        solution = None
        if lm_max_iter > 0:
            solver.set_hessian_approximation("limited-memory")
            solver.set_maximum_iterations(lm_max_iter)
            solver.show_online_optim = (ex_max_iter == 0) and not disable_plot
            solution = self.ocp.solve(solver)

        if lm_max_iter > 0 and ex_max_iter > 0:
            self.ocp.set_warm_start(solution)

        if ex_max_iter > 0:
            solver.set_hessian_approximation("exact")
            solver.set_maximum_iterations(ex_max_iter)
            solver.set_warm_start_options()
            solver.show_online_optim = not disable_plot
            solution = self.ocp.solve(solver)

        return solution

import torch
from pytorch_metric_learning.utils import common_functions as pml_cf
from ..utils import common_functions as c_f

def aggregate_losses(reduction_func, loss_weights, scaling_factor, loss_collection):
    if "total" in loss_collection:
        raise ValueError("'total' is a reserved key. Please choose another name for the loss")
    
    c_f.validate_keys_match(loss_weights, "loss_weights", loss_collection)
    
    weighted_components = []
    component_values = {}
    
    for name, value in loss_collection.items():
        try:
            # Apply weight if specified, otherwise use original value
            weighted_value = value * loss_weights.get(name, 1.0)
            # Apply global scaling factor
            scaled_value = weighted_value * scaling_factor
            weighted_components.append(scaled_value)
            component_values[name] = scaled_value.item()
        except Exception as error:
            c_f.prepend_error_context(error, f"Encountered issue while processing loss component '{name}'")
            raise
    
    # Combine all components using reduction function
    combined_loss = reduction_func(weighted_components)
    component_values["total"] = combined_loss.item()
    
    return combined_loss, component_values

class LossWeightAggregator:
    """
    Applies scalar weights to individual losses and aggregates them into a single loss value.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        aggregation_method: Callable[[List[torch.Tensor]], torch.Tensor],
        loss_weights: Dict[str, float] = None,
        global_scale: float = 1.0,
    ):
        """
        Parameters:
            aggregation_method: Function that combines a list of losses into one scalar loss.
            loss_weights: Dictionary mapping loss names to their respective weights.
                         If None, all losses are equally weighted (weight=1).
            global_scale: Global multiplier applied to all losses before aggregation.
        """
        self.aggregation_method = aggregation_method
        self.loss_weights = c_f.default(loss_weights, {})
        self.global_scale = global_scale
        pml_cf.register_attributes(self, ["loss_weights", "global_scale"])
    
    def __call__(
        self, loss_dict: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, float]]:
        """
        Process input losses by applying weights and scaling, then aggregate.
        
        Arguments:
            loss_dict: Mapping from loss identifiers to their tensor values.
            
        Returns:
            A tuple where:
                - First element is the final differentiable loss for backpropagation.
                - Second element is a dictionary of detached loss components (floats).
        """
        return aggregate_losses(
            self.aggregation_method, 
            self.loss_weights, 
            self.global_scale, 
            loss_dict
        )
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return c_f.format_repr(
            self, 
            c_f.describe_instance(self, ["loss_weights", "global_scale"]), 
            {}
        )

from traits.api import Dict, HasTraits
from apptools.selection.errors import (
    ProviderNotRegisteredError,
    IDConflictError,
    ListenerNotConnectedError,
)

class SelectionService(HasTraits):
    """Manages the registration of selection providers and listeners for selection events.
    
    This service acts as a central hub that maintains associations between unique
    provider identifiers and their corresponding selection providers. It supports
    both active querying of selections and passive subscription via listeners.
    """
    
    #### 'SelectionService' protocol ##########################################
    
    def register_provider(self, provider):
        """Register a new selection provider under its identifier.
        
        If a provider with the same identifier already exists, an :class:`~.IDConflictError`
        is raised to prevent accidental overwrites.
        
        Parameters:
            provider -- ISelectionProvider
                The selection provider instance to be registered.
        """
        pid = provider.provider_id
        if self._is_registered(pid):
            raise IDConflictError(provider_id=pid)
        self._providers[pid] = provider
        if pid in self._listeners:
            self._notify_all_listeners(pid)
            
    def _is_registered(self, provider_id):
        """Check whether a provider with the given ID is currently registered."""
        return provider_id in self._providers
        
    def unregister_provider(self, provider):
        """Unregister an existing selection provider.
        
        Raises :class:`~.ProviderNotRegisteredError` if the provider was never registered.
        
        Parameters:
            provider -- ISelectionProvider
                The selection provider instance to be removed.
        """
        pid = provider.provider_id
        self._ensure_registered(pid)
        if pid in self._listeners:
            self._remove_all_notifications(pid)
        del self._providers[pid]
        
    def request_selection(self, provider_id):
        """Fetch the current selection from a registered provider.
        
        Parameters:
            provider_id -- str
                Unique identifier of the target provider.
                
        Returns:
            selection -- ISelection
                The current selection state of the provider.
                
        Raises:
            ProviderNotRegisteredError: if no provider with the given ID exists.
        """
        self._ensure_registered(provider_id)
        provider = self._providers[provider_id]
        return provider.get_selection()
        
    def update_selection(self, provider_id, items, skip_missing=False):
        """Update the selection state of a registered provider.
        
        Parameters:
            provider_id -- str
                Identifier of the provider whose selection should change.
            items -- list
                Collection of items to set as the new selection.
            skip_missing -- bool (default: False)
                If True, silently ignore items not present in the provider's domain.
                Otherwise, raise ValueError on missing items.
                
        Raises:
            ProviderNotRegisteredError: if provider not found.
        """
        self._ensure_registered(provider_id)
        provider = self._providers[provider_id]
        return provider.set_selection(items, ignore_missing=skip_missing)
        
    def subscribe_to_selection(self, provider_id, callback):
        """Subscribe a listener function to receive selection updates.
        
        The callback will be invoked:
          - Immediately upon subscription if the provider is already registered,
            passing its initial selection.
          - On every subsequent selection change event from the provider.
          
        Subscriptions persist across provider re-registration cycles.
        
        Parameters:
            provider_id -- str
                Identifier of the provider to monitor.
            callback -- callable(i_selection)
                Function accepting one argument (the selection object).
        """
        self._listeners.setdefault(provider_id, [])
        self._listeners[provider_id].append(callback)
        if self._is_registered(provider_id):
            self._apply_listener(provider_id, callback, activate=True)
            
    def unsubscribe_from_selection(self, provider_id, callback):
        """Remove a previously registered listener.
        
        Parameters:
            provider_id -- str
                Identifier of the provider being monitored.
            callback -- callable
                Previously subscribed listener function.
                
        Raises:
            ListenerNotConnectedError: if the listener wasn't previously registered.
        """
        if self._is_registered(provider_id):
            self._apply_listener(provider_id, callback, activate=False)
        try:
            self._listeners[provider_id].remove(callback)
        except (ValueError, KeyError):
            raise ListenerNotConnectedError(
                provider_id=provider_id, listener=callback
            )
            
    #### Private helpers ######################################################
    
    _listeners = Dict()
    _providers = Dict()
    
    def _apply_listener(self, provider_id, func, activate):
        """Enable or disable trait notifications for a specific listener."""
        provider = self._providers[provider_id]
        provider.on_trait_change(func, "selection", remove=not activate)
        
    def _notify_all_listeners(self, provider_id):
        """Trigger all registered listeners with the current selection."""
        provider = self._providers[provider_id]
        current = provider.get_selection()
        for cb in self._listeners[provider_id]:
            self._apply_listener(provider_id, cb, activate=True)
            # Note: error handling could be improved here using traits hooks
            cb(current)
            
    def _remove_all_notifications(self, provider_id):
        """Disable all listeners associated with a provider."""
        for cb in self._listeners[provider_id]:
            self._apply_listener(provider_id, cb, activate=False)
            
    def _ensure_registered(self, provider_id):
        """Raise exception unless provider is registered."""
        if not self._is_registered(provider_id):
            raise ProviderNotRegisteredError(provider_id=provider_id)

# Reimplementation of BaseExperiment with equivalent logic but altered structure

from kondo import Experiment
from tqdm.auto import tqdm
import functools
import torch
from torchrl.envs import make_gym_env, ParallelEnvs
from torchrl.utils.storage import Transition
from torchrl.controllers import Controller, RandomController


def log_metrics_to_logger(logger, metrics: dict, prefix: str, step=None):
    for key, value in metrics.items():
        if value is not None:
            try:
                logger.add_scalar(f'{prefix}/{key}', value, global_step=step)
            except AssertionError:
                # Non-scalar values are skipped silently
                continue


class BaseExperiment(Experiment):
    def __init__(self, environment_id: str = None, num_parallel_envs: int = 1,
                 total_frames: int = int(1e3), exploration_frames: int = 0,
                 train_frequency: int = 100, **kwargs):
        assert environment_id is not None, '"environment_id" cannot be None'
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.device = torch.device('cuda' if self.cuda else 'cpu')
        self.total_frames = total_frames
        self.exploration_frames = exploration_frames
        self.train_frequency = train_frequency
        self.num_parallel_envs = num_parallel_envs
        
        env_constructor = functools.partial(make_gym_env, environment_id)
        self.parallel_envs = ParallelEnvs(env_constructor, n_envs=num_parallel_envs, base_seed=self.seed)
        
        self.policy_controller = self._instantiate_controller()
        self.current_frame_count = 0

    def _instantiate_controller(self) -> Controller:
        return RandomController(self.parallel_envs.action_space)

    def select_action(self, observations: list) -> list:
        if self.current_frame_count < self.exploration_frames:
            return RandomController(self.parallel_envs.action_space).act(observations)
        return self.policy_controller.act(observations)

    def buffer_transitions(self, transitions: list):
        """Placeholder method for storing transitions."""
        pass

    def execute_training_step(self) -> dict:
        """Placeholder method for training logic."""
        return {}

    def run_experiment(self):
        progress_bar = tqdm(initial=self.current_frame_count,
                            total=self.total_frames, unit='steps')
        
        current_observations = self.parallel_envs.reset(list(range(self.parallel_envs.n_procs)))
        
        while self.current_frame_count < self.total_frames:
            selected_actions = self.select_action(current_observations)
            
            step_results = self.parallel_envs.step(
                list(range(self.parallel_envs.n_procs)), 
                selected_actions
            )
            
            progress_bar.update(self.parallel_envs.n_procs)
            
            batch_transitions = []
            
            proc_idx = 0
            while proc_idx < len(current_observations):
                obs, action, (next_obs, reward, terminated, _) = \
                    current_observations[proc_idx], selected_actions[proc_idx], step_results[proc_idx]
                
                current_observations[proc_idx] = next_obs
                self.current_frame_count += 1
                
                batch_transitions.append(
                    Transition(obs=obs, action=action,
                               reward=reward, next_obs=next_obs,
                               done=terminated)
                )
                
                if terminated:
                    info_dict = self.parallel_envs.exec_remote('info', proc_list=[proc_idx])[0]
                    log_metrics_to_logger(self.logger, info_dict, tag='episode',
                                          step=self.current_frame_count)
                    current_observations[proc_idx] = self.parallel_envs.reset([proc_idx])[0]
                
                proc_idx += 1
            
            self.buffer_transitions(batch_transitions)
            
            if (self.current_frame_count >= self.exploration_frames and
                self.current_frame_count % self.train_frequency == 0):
                training_info = self.execute_training_step()
                log_metrics_to_logger(self.logger, training_info, tag='train',
                                      step=self.current_frame_count)
        
        self.logger.close()
        self.parallel_envs.close()

import itertools

def center_and_norm_inplace(data, axis=-1):
    """Centers and normalizes data in-place along specified axis"""
    # Shift axis to work on last dimension
    shifted = np.rollaxis(data, axis)
    # Center by subtracting mean
    shifted -= shifted.mean(axis=0)
    # Normalize by standard deviation
    std_dev = shifted.std(axis=0)
    # Avoid division by zero
    std_dev[std_dev == 0] = 1.0
    shifted /= std_dev


def test_gs_orthonormalization():
    """Test Gram-Schmidt orthonormalization procedure"""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(42)
    
    # Create orthogonal matrix using SVD
    random_matrix = rng.randn(8, 8)
    U, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd(random_matrix)
    orthogonal_basis = U
    
    # Test decorrelation of random vector
    test_vector = rng.randn(8)
    _gs_decorrelation(test_vector, orthogonal_basis, 8)
    assert np.sum(test_vector ** 2) < 1e-10
    
    # Test partial decorrelation
    new_vector = rng.randn(8)
    result = _gs_decorrelation(new_vector, orthogonal_basis, 4)
    projection = np.dot(result, orthogonal_basis.T)
    assert np.sum(projection[:4] ** 2) < 1e-10


@pytest.mark.filterwarnings(
    "ignore:From version 1.3 whiten='unit-variance' will be used by default."
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("noise_flag", [True, False])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("random_seed", [123])
def test_fastica_basic(noise_flag, random_seed):
    """Basic FastICA test on synthetic data"""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_seed)
    n_obs = 500
    
    # Generate source signals
    source1 = (2 * np.sin(np.linspace(0, 50, n_obs)) > 0).astype(float)
    source2 = stats.t.rvs(2, size=n_obs, random_state=rng)
    sources = np.vstack([source1, source2])
    
    # Center and normalize sources
    center_and_norm_inplace(sources)
    source1, source2 = sources
    
    # Mixing matrix construction
    angle = np.pi / 4
    mixing_matrix = np.array([
        [np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)],
        [np.sin(angle), -np.cos(angle)]
    ])
    
    # Create mixed signals
    mixed_signals = mixing_matrix @ sources
    if noise_flag:
        mixed_signals += 0.05 * rng.randn(*mixed_signals.shape)
    
    # Center mixed signals
    center_and_norm_inplace(mixed_signals)
    
    # Custom nonlinearity function
    def custom_g(x):
        return x**3, (3 * x**2).mean(axis=-1)
    
    algorithms = ["parallel", "deflation"]
    nonlinearities = ["logcosh", "exp", "cube", custom_g]
    whitening_options = ["arbitrary-variance", "unit-variance", False]
    
    for algo, nl, whiten in itertools.product(algorithms, nonlinearities, whitening_options):
        if whiten:
            components, mixing_est, sources_est = fastica(
                mixed_signals.T, fun=nl, whiten=whiten, algorithm=algo, random_state=rng
            )
            # Should raise error with invalid function
            with pytest.raises(ValueError):
                fastica(mixed_signals.T, fun=np.exp, whiten=whiten, algorithm=algo)
        else:
            # Apply PCA when not whitening
            pca_model = PCA(n_components=2, whiten=True, random_state=rng)
            transformed = pca_model.fit_transform(mixed_signals.T)
            components, mixing_est, sources_est = fastica(
                transformed, fun=nl, algorithm=algo, whiten=False, random_state=rng
            )
            # Should raise error with invalid function
            with pytest.raises(ValueError):
                fastica(transformed, fun=np.exp, algorithm=algo)
        
        sources_est = sources_est.T
        
        # Verify mixing model relationship
        if whiten:
            reconstructed = np.dot(np.dot(mixing_est, components), mixed_signals)
            assert_almost_equal(sources_est, reconstructed, decimal=5)
        
        # Normalize estimated sources
        center_and_norm_inplace(sources_est)
        est_source1, est_source2 = sources_est
        
        # Handle possible wrong ordering
        if abs(np.dot(est_source1, source2)) > abs(np.dot(est_source1, source1)):
            est_source1, est_source2 = est_source2, est_source1
        
        # Align signs
        est_source1 *= np.sign(np.dot(est_source1, source1))
        est_source2 *= np.sign(np.dot(est_source2, source2))
        
        # Check reconstruction quality
        if not noise_flag:
            correlation1 = np.dot(est_source1, source1) / n_obs
            correlation2 = np.dot(est_source2, source2) / n_obs
            assert_almost_equal(correlation1, 1.0, decimal=2)
            assert_almost_equal(correlation2, 1.0, decimal=2)
        else:
            correlation1 = np.dot(est_source1, source1) / n_obs
            correlation2 = np.dot(est_source2, source2) / n_obs
            assert_almost_equal(correlation1, 1.0, decimal=1)
            assert_almost_equal(correlation2, 1.0, decimal=1)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("add_noise", [True, False])
def test_non_square_ica(add_noise):
    """Test FastICA with non-square mixing matrix"""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(456)
    n_samples = 600
    
    # Generate sources
    t_vals = np.linspace(0, 30, n_samples)
    s1 = np.sin(t_vals)
    s2 = np.ceil(np.sin(2 * np.pi * t_vals))
    sources = np.vstack([s1, s2])
    
    center_and_norm_inplace(sources)
    s1_clean, s2_clean = sources
    
    # Non-square mixing matrix
    mixing_matrix = rng.randn(7, 2)
    observations = mixing_matrix @ sources
    
    if add_noise:
        observations += 0.02 * rng.randn(*observations.shape)
    
    center_and_norm_inplace(observations)
    
    # Apply FastICA
    components, mixing_est, sources_est = fastica(
        observations.T, n_components=2, whiten="unit-variance", random_state=rng
    )
    
    sources_est = sources_est.T
    
    # Check mixing model
    reconstructed = np.dot(np.dot(mixing_est, components), observations)
    assert_almost_equal(sources_est, reconstructed, decimal=5)
    
    # Normalize and align
    center_and_norm_inplace(sources_est)
    est_s1, est_s2 = sources_est
    
    if abs(np.dot(est_s1, s2_clean)) > abs(np.dot(est_s1, s1_clean)):
        est_s1, est_s2 = est_s2, est_s1
    
    est_s1 *= np.sign(np.dot(est_s1, s1_clean))
    est_s2 *= np.sign(np.dot(est_s2, s2_clean))
    
    # Verify reconstruction accuracy
    if not add_noise:
        corr1 = np.dot(est_s1, s1_clean) / n_samples
        corr2 = np.dot(est_s2, s2_clean) / n_samples
        assert_almost_equal(corr1, 1.0, decimal=3)
        assert_almost_equal(corr2, 1.0, decimal=3)

import math
import typing as t
from collections import abc
from itertools import cycle
import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from cycler import cycler
from pygaps import logger
from pygaps.graphing.labels import label_lgd
from pygaps.graphing.labels import label_units_dict
from pygaps.graphing.mpl_styles import BASE_STYLE
from pygaps.graphing.mpl_styles import ISO_MARKERS
from pygaps.graphing.mpl_styles import ISO_STYLE

from pygaps.graphing.mpl_styles import Y2_COLORS

# Mapping branch identifiers to boolean flags for adsorption/desorption inclusion
_BRANCH_MAP = {
    "adsorption": (True, False),
    "desorption": (False, True),
    "complete": (True, True),
}

@mpl.rc_context(BASE_STYLE)
@mpl.rc_context(ISO_STYLE)
def draw_isotherm(
    iso_list,
    axes=None,
    x_key: str = 'pressure',
    y_left_key: str = 'loading',
    y_right_key: str = None,
    segment: str = "complete",
    x_limits: t.Tuple[float, float] = (None, None),
    y_left_limits: t.Tuple[float, float] = (None, None),
    y_right_limits: t.Tuple[float, float] = (None, None),
    eval_x_points: t.Iterable[float] = None,
    eval_y_points: t.Iterable[float] = None,
    mass_basis: str = None,
    mass_unit: str = None,
    loading_type: str = None,
    loading_measure: str = None,
    pressure_form: str = None,
    pressure_scale: str = None,
    scale_x_log: bool = False,
    scale_y_left_log: bool = False,
    scale_y_right_log: bool = False,
    palette: t.Union[bool, str, t.Iterable[str]] = True,
    point_style: t.Union[bool, str, t.Iterable[str]] = True,
    left_line_opts: dict = None,
    right_line_opts: dict = None,
    legend_fields: list = None,
    legend_loc: str = 'best',
    output_file: str = None,
):
    """
    Visualize one or more isotherms on a shared plot.
    
    Parameters are analogous to those in the original `plot_iso`, with renamed arguments
    and internal logic adjusted accordingly.
    """
    # Ensure iterable input
    if not isinstance(iso_list, abc.Iterable):
        iso_list = [iso_list]
    else:
        iso_list = list(iso_list)

    # Validate required keys
    if not x_key or not y_left_key:
        raise ParameterError("Both x-axis and left y-axis data must be specified.")

    # Check presence of keys across all isotherms
    for iso in iso_list:
        if x_key not in _extract_keys(iso):
            raise GraphingError(f"Isotherm missing '{x_key}' data.")
        if y_left_key not in _extract_keys(iso):
            raise GraphingError(f"Isotherm missing '{y_left_key}' data.")
    if y_right_key:
        present_count = sum(y_right_key in _extract_keys(iso) for iso in iso_list)
        if present_count == 0:
            raise GraphingError(f"No isotherm contains '{y_right_key}' data.")
        elif present_count < len(iso_list):
            logger.warning(f"Some isotherms lack '{y_right_key}' data")

    # Parse segment selection
    if segment not in _BRANCH_MAP:
        raise GraphingError(
            f"Invalid segment type '{segment}'. Valid options: {list(_BRANCH_MAP.keys())}"
        )
    include_ads, include_des = _BRANCH_MAP[segment]

    # Default values for optional dicts/lists
    left_line_opts = left_line_opts or {}
    right_line_opts = right_line_opts or {}
    legend_fields = legend_fields or []

    # Unit conversion parameters — fallback to first isotherm where applicable
    unit_cfg = {
        'pressure_form': pressure_form or iso_list[0].pressure_form,
        'pressure_scale': pressure_scale or iso_list[0].pressure_scale,
        'loading_type': loading_type or iso_list[0].loading_type,
        'loading_measure': loading_measure or iso_list[0].loading_measure,
        'mass_basis': mass_basis or iso_list[0].mass_basis,
        'mass_unit': mass_unit or iso_list[0].mass_unit,
    }

    # Range and evaluation settings
    range_cfg = {
        'x_minmax': x_limits,
        'y_left_minmax': y_left_limits,
        'y_right_minmax': y_right_limits,
        'x_eval': eval_x_points,
        'y_eval': eval_y_points,
    }

    log_cfg = {
        'x': scale_x_log,
        'y_left': scale_y_left_log,
        'y_right': scale_y_right_log,
    }

    # Setup figure/axes
    if axes:
        main_ax = axes
        fig = main_ax.figure
    else:
        fig = plt.figure()
        main_ax = fig.add_subplot(111)

    # Secondary axis only if needed
    sec_ax = main_ax.twinx() if y_right_key else None

    # Styling cycles
    left_colors = _resolve_palette(palette, Y1_COLORS)
    right_colors = _resolve_palette(palette, Y2_COLORS)
    left_color_cycle = cycler('color', left_colors)
    right_color_cycle = cycler('color', right_colors)

    markers = _resolve_markers(point_style)
    left_marker_cycle = cycler('marker', markers)
    right_marker_cycle = cycler('marker', reversed(markers))

    left_style = _compose_cycles(left_marker_cycle, left_color_cycle, bool(point_style))
    right_style = _compose_cycles(right_marker_cycle, right_color_cycle, bool(point_style))

    # Axis labels
    main_ax.set_xlabel(label_units_dict(x_key, unit_cfg))
    main_ax.set_ylabel(label_units_dict(y_left_key, unit_cfg))
    if sec_ax:
        sec_ax.set_ylabel(label_units_dict(y_right_key, unit_cfg))

    # Plotting loop
    for iso in iso_list:
        left_sty = next(left_style)
        right_sty = next(right_style)
        left_sty.update(left_line_opts)
        right_sty.update(right_line_opts)

        has_ads = iso.has_segment('ads')
        has_des = iso.has_segment('des')

        if include_ads and has_ads:
            x1_vals, y1_vals, x2_vals, y2_vals = _fetch_data(
                iso,
                'ads',
                x_key=x_key,
                y_left_key=y_left_key,
                y_right_key=y_right_key,
                unit_cfg=unit_cfg,
                range_cfg=range_cfg,
            )

            label_left = label_lgd(iso, legend_fields, 'ads', y_left_key)
            main_ax.plot(x1_vals, y1_vals, label=label_left, **left_sty)

            if y_right_key and y2_vals is not None:
                label_right = label_lgd(iso, legend_fields, 'ads', y_right_key)
                sec_ax.plot(x2_vals, y2_vals, label=label_right, **right_sty)

        # Modify style for desorption
        left_sty['markerfacecolor'] = 'white'
        left_sty['linestyle'] = '--'
        right_sty['markerfacecolor'] = 'white'

        if include_des and has_des:
            x1_vals, y1_vals, x2_vals, y2_vals = _fetch_data(
                iso,
                'des',
                x_key=x_key,
                y_left_key=y_left_key,
                y_right_key=y_right_key,
                unit_cfg=unit_cfg,
                range_cfg=range_cfg,
            )

            # Suppress duplicate labels when both branches shown
            if segment == "complete" and 'branch' not in legend_fields and has_ads:
                label_left = ''
            else:
                label_left = label_lgd(iso, legend_fields, 'des', y_left_key)
            main_ax.plot(x1_vals, y1_vals, label=label_left, **left_sty)

            if y_right_key and y2_vals is not None:
                if segment == "complete" and 'branch' not in legend_fields and has_ads:
                    label_right = ''
                else:
                    label_right = label_lgd(iso, legend_fields, 'des', y_right_key)
                sec_ax.plot(x2_vals, y2_vals, label=label_right, **right_sty)

    # Final formatting
    _finalize_plot(
        fig,
        main_ax,
        sec_ax,
        log_cfg,
        range_cfg,
        legend_loc,
        output_file,
    )

    return (main_ax, sec_ax) if sec_ax else main_ax


def _extract_keys(iso):
    """Return list of available keys in an isotherm."""
    return ['loading', 'pressure'] + iso.other_keys


def _resolve_palette(pal, default):
    """Determine color palette based on user input."""
    if pal:
        if isinstance(pal, bool):
            return default
        if isinstance(pal, int):
            return default[:pal] if pal <= len(default) else default
        if isinstance(pal, abc.Iterable):
            return list(pal)
        raise ParameterError("Invalid palette specification.")
    return ['black', 'gray', 'silver']


def _resolve_markers(style):
    """Resolve marker style configuration."""
    if style:
        if isinstance(style, bool):
            return ISO_MARKERS
        if isinstance(style, int):
            n = min(style, len(ISO_MARKERS))
            return ISO_MARKERS[:n]
        if isinstance(style, abc.Iterable):
            return list(style)
        raise ParameterError("Invalid marker specification.")
    return []


def _compose_cycles(cyc_a, cyc_b, combine):
    """Compose two cycler objects into a combined cycle."""
    if combine:
        return cycle(cyc_a * cyc_b)
    len_a = len(cyc_a)
    len_b = len(cyc_b)
    if len_a == 0:
        return cycle(cyc_b)
    if len_b == 0:
        return cycle(cyc_a)
    if len_a > len_b:
        return cycle(cyc_a + (cyc_b * math.ceil(len_a / len_b))[:len_a])
    return cycle(cyc_b + (cyc_a * math.ceil(len_b / len_a))[:len_b])


def _fetch_data(
    iso,
    seg_name,
    *,
    x_key,
    y_left_key,
    y_right_key,
    unit_cfg,
    range_cfg,
):
    """Retrieve plotted data for a given segment."""
    if range_cfg['x_eval'] is None and range_cfg['y_eval'] is None:
        # Standard indexed data retrieval
        x_vals = _get_column(
            iso,
            x_key,
            seg_name,
            unit_cfg,
            range_cfg['x_minmax'],
        )
        y_left_vals = _get_column(
            iso,
            y_left_key,
            seg_name,
            unit_cfg,
            range_cfg['y_left_minmax'],
        )
        x_vals, y_left_vals = x_vals.align(y_left_vals, join='inner')

        y_right_vals = None
        x_right_vals = None
        if y_right_key and y_right_key in _extract_keys(iso):
            y_right_vals = _get_column(
                iso,
                y_right_key,
                seg_name,
                unit_cfg,
                range_cfg['y_right_minmax'],
            )
            x_right_vals, y_right_vals = x_vals.align(y_right_vals, join='inner')
    else:
        if range_cfg['x_eval'] is not None:
            x_vals = range_cfg['x_eval']
            y_left_vals = _get_column(
                iso,
                y_left_key,
                seg_name,
                unit_cfg,
                range_cfg['y_left_minmax'],
                points=range_cfg['x_eval'],
            )
        elif range_cfg['y_eval'] is not None:
            x_vals = _get_column(
                iso,
                x_key,
                seg_name,
                unit_cfg,
                range_cfg['x_minmax'],
                points=range_cfg['y_eval'],
            )
            y_left_vals = range_cfg['y_eval']

        y_right_vals = None
        x_right_vals = None

    return x_vals, y_left_vals, x_right_vals, y_right_vals


def _get_column(
    iso,
    col_name,
    seg_name,
    unit_cfg,
    lim=None,
    points=None,
):
    """Extract column data from isotherm."""
    kwargs = {'segment': seg_name}
    if col_name == 'pressure':
        kwargs['pressure_form'] = unit_cfg['pressure_form']
        kwargs['pressure_scale'] = unit_cfg['pressure_scale']
        if points is not None:
            return iso.pressure_at(points, **kwargs)
        return iso.pressure(limits=lim, indexed=True, **kwargs)
    elif col_name == 'loading':
        kwargs['loading_type'] = unit_cfg['loading_type']
        kwargs['loading_measure'] = unit_cfg['loading_measure']
        kwargs['mass_basis'] = unit_cfg['mass_basis']
        kwargs['mass_unit'] = unit_cfg['mass_unit']
        if points is not None:
            return iso.loading_at(points, **kwargs)
        return iso.loading(limits=lim, indexed=True, **kwargs)
    return iso.other_data(col_name, limits=lim, indexed=True, **kwargs)


def _finalize_plot(
    fig,
    ax_main,
    ax_sec,
    log_opts,
    range_opts,
    legend_pos,
    out_path,
):
    """Apply final visual adjustments and save if requested."""
    if log_opts['x']:
        ax_main.set_xscale('log')
    if log_opts['y_left']:
        ax_main.set_yscale('log')
    if ax_sec and log_opts['y_right']:
        ax_sec.set_yscale('log')

    ax_main.set_xlim(range_opts['x_minmax'])
    ax_main.set_ylim(range_opts['y_left_minmax'])
    if ax_sec:
        ax_sec.set_ylim(range_opts['y_right_minmax'])

    legend_artists = []
    if legend_pos is not None:
        handles_main, labels_main = ax_main.get_legend_handles_labels()
        if ax_sec:
            handles_sec, labels_sec = ax_sec.get_legend_handles_labels()
            handles_main.extend(handles_sec)
            labels_main.extend(labels_sec)

        if legend_pos in ['out left', 'out right', 'out bottom', 'out top']:
            extra_kwargs = {'bbox_transform': fig.transFigure}
            if legend_pos == 'out top':
                extra_kwargs.update({'bbox_to_anchor': (0.5, 1), 'loc': 'lower center', 'ncol': 2})
            elif legend_pos == 'out bottom':
                extra_kwargs.update({'bbox_to_anchor': (0.5, 0), 'loc': 'upper center', 'ncol': 2})
            elif legend_pos == 'out right':
                extra_kwargs.update({'bbox_to_anchor': (1, 0.5), 'loc': 'center left'})
            elif legend_pos == 'out left':
                extra_kwargs.update({'bbox_to_anchor': (0, 0.5), 'loc': 'center right'})
            lgd = fig.legend(handles_main, labels_main, **extra_kwargs)
        else:
            lgd = ax_main.legend(handles_main, labels_main, loc=legend_pos)
        legend_artists.append(lgd)

    fig.tight_layout()

    if out_path:
        fig.savefig(
            out_path,
            bbox_extra_artists=legend_artists,
            bbox_inches='tight',
            dpi=300,
        )

import logging
from typing import Dict, Any
from signedjson.sign import sign_json
from synapse.api.errors import Codes, SynapseError
from synapse.http.servlet import (
    RestServlet,
    assert_params_in_dict,
    parse_json_object_from_request,
)
from synapse.types import UserID
from ._base import client_patterns

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class UserDirectorySearchHandler(RestServlet):
    ENDPOINT_PATH = "/user_directory/search"
    
    def __init__(self, homeserver):
        """
        Args:
            homeserver (synapse.server.HomeServer): The homeserver instance
        """
        super().__init__()
        self.homeserver = homeserver
        self.authentication = homeserver.get_auth()
        self.user_directory_service = homeserver.get_user_directory_handler()
        self.simple_http_client = homeserver.get_simple_http_client()

    async def handle_POST_request(self, request):
        """Processes user directory search requests
        
        Returns:
            tuple: HTTP status code and response body containing search results
        """
        # Authenticate the requesting user
        requester = await self.authentication.get_user_by_req(request, allow_guest=False)
        local_user_id = requester.user.to_string()
        
        # Check if directory search is enabled
        if not self.homeserver.config.user_directory_search_enabled:
            return 200, {"limited": False, "results": []}
        
        # Parse request body
        request_body = parse_json_object_from_request(request)
        
        # Handle federation delegation if configured
        if self.homeserver.config.user_directory_defer_to_id_server:
            signed_payload = sign_json(
                request_body, 
                self.homeserver.hostname, 
                self.homeserver.config.signing_key[0]
            )
            id_server_url = "%s/_matrix/identity/api/v1/user_directory/search" % (
                self.homeserver.config.user_directory_defer_to_id_server,
            )
            server_response = await self.simple_http_client.post_json_get_json(id_server_url, signed_payload)
            return 200, server_response
        
        # Process search parameters
        max_results = min(request_body.get("limit", 10), 50)
        
        if "search_term" not in request_body:
            raise SynapseError(400, "`search_term` is required field")
        
        search_query = request_body["search_term"]
        
        # Execute search
        search_results = await self.user_directory_service.search_users(
            local_user_id, search_query, max_results
        )
        
        return 200, search_results


class UserProfileLookupHandler(RestServlet):
    """
    Legacy endpoint for retrieving single user profile information.
    Deprecated in favor of /users/info endpoint.
    GET /user/{user_id}/info HTTP/1.1
    """
    ENDPOINT_PATTERN = "/user/(?P<user_id>[^/]*)/info$"
    
    def __init__(self, homeserver):
        super().__init__()
        self.homeserver = homeserver
        self.auth_system = homeserver.get_auth()
        self.database = homeserver.get_datastore()
        self.federation_transport = homeserver.get_federation_transport_client()
        
        # Register federation query handler if available
        federation_registry = homeserver.get_federation_registry()
        if "user_info" not in federation_registry.query_handlers:
            federation_registry.register_query_handler("user_info", self._handle_federation_request)

    async def handle_GET_request(self, request, user_id):
        # Verify authentication
        await self.auth_system.get_user_by_req(request)
        
        target_user = UserID.from_string(user_id)
        
        # Check if user belongs to local homeserver
        if not self.homeserver.is_mine(target_user):
            # Query remote server via federation
            query_args = {"user_id": user_id}
            remote_response = await self.federation_transport.make_query(
                target_user.domain, "user_info", query_args, retry_on_dns_fail=True
            )
            return 200, remote_response
        
        # Fetch local user info
        user_profiles = await self.database.get_info_for_users([user_id])
        return 200, user_profiles[user_id]
    
    async def _handle_federation_request(self, query_params):
        """Handles incoming federation requests for user information
        
        Args:
            query_params (dict): Dictionary containing query parameters
            
        Returns:
            dict: User information dictionary
        """
        requested_user_id = query_params.get("user_id")
        if not requested_user_id:
            raise SynapseError(400, "user_id not provided")
        
        user_obj = UserID.from_string(requested_user_id)
        if not self.homeserver.is_mine(user_obj):
            raise SynapseError(400, "User is not hosted on this homeserver")
        
        user_info = await self.database.get_info_for_users([requested_user_id])
        return user_info[requested_user_id]


class BulkUserInfoHandler(RestServlet):
    """Bulk endpoint for retrieving multiple user profiles
    GET /users/info HTTP/1.1
    Returns a mapping of user IDs to their profile information
    Supports both local and remote users
    """
    ENDPOINT_PATTERN = "/users/info$"
    
    def __init__(self, homeserver):
        super().__init__()
        self.homeserver = homeserver
        self.auth_system = homeserver.get_auth()
        self.database = homeserver.get_datastore()
        self.federation_transport = homeserver.get_federation_transport_client()

    async def handle_POST_request(self, request):
        # Verify authentication
        await self.auth_system.get_user_by_req(request)
        
        # Extract and validate request body
        request_body = parse_json_object_from_request(request)
        assert_params_in_dict(request_body, required=["user_ids"])
        
        requested_user_ids = request_body["user_ids"]
        if not isinstance(requested_user_ids, list):
            raise SynapseError(
                400,
                "'user_ids' must be a list of user ID strings",
                errcode=Codes.INVALID_PARAM,
            )
        
        # Categorize users by domain
        local_users = set()
        remote_requests = {}  # type: Dict[str, set]
        
        for user_id in requested_user_ids:
            user_obj = UserID.from_string(user_id)
            if self.homeserver.is_mine(user_obj):
                local_users.add(user_id)
            else:
                remote_requests.setdefault(user_obj.domain, set())
                remote_requests[user_obj.domain].add(user_id)
        
        # Gather local user information
        user_profile_map = await self.database.get_info_for_users(local_users)
        
        # Fetch remote user information
        for server_name, user_set in remote_requests.items():
            remote_info = await self.federation_transport.get_info_of_users(
                server_name, list(user_set)
            )
            user_profile_map.update(remote_info)
        
        return 200, user_profile_map


def register_endpoints(homeserver, http_router):
    """Registers all user information related endpoints with the HTTP router"""
    UserDirectorySearchHandler(homeserver).register(http_router)
    UserProfileLookupHandler(homeserver).register(http_router)
    BulkUserInfoHandler(homeserver).register(http_router)

# Custom Mask R-CNN Task Implementation for Training and Evaluation

import tensorflow as tf
from absl import logging
from official.core import base_task, input_reader, task_factory
from official.vision.beta.configs import maskrcnn as exp_cfg
from official.vision.beta.dataloaders import (
    maskrcnn_input,
    tf_example_decoder,
    tf_example_label_map_decoder,
)
from official.vision.beta.evaluation import coco_evaluator
from official.vision.beta.losses import maskrcnn_losses
from official.vision.beta.modeling import factory


@task_factory.register_task_cls(exp_cfg.MaskRCNNTask)
class CustomMaskRCNNTask(base_task.Task):
    """Custom implementation of Mask R-CNN training/evaluation pipeline.
    
    This class handles dataset loading, model construction, loss computation,
    metric tracking, forward/backward passes, and evaluation using COCO metrics.
    """

    def build_model(self):
        """Constructs the Mask R-CNN architecture."""
        input_specs = tf.keras.layers.InputSpec(
            shape=[None] + self.task_config.model.input_size
        )
        l2_decay = self.task_config.losses.l2_weight_decay
        
        # Apply standard L2 regularization scaling (divide by 2 to match tf.nn.l2_loss)
        reg_strength = l2_decay / 2.0 if l2_decay else None
        regularizer = (
            tf.keras.regularizers.l2(reg_strength) if reg_strength else None
        )

        return factory.build_maskrcnn(
            input_specs=input_specs,
            model_config=self.task_config.model,
            l2_regularizer=regularizer,
        )

    def initialize(self, model: tf.keras.Model):
        """Loads pretrained weights from checkpoint."""
        init_path = self.task_config.init_checkpoint
        if not init_path:
            return

        # Handle directory vs file paths for checkpoints
        if tf.io.gfile.isdir(init_path):
            init_path = tf.train.latest_checkpoint(init_path)

        # Restore based on specified modules
        module_selection = self.task_config.init_checkpoint_modules
        if module_selection == 'all':
            ckpt = tf.train.Checkpoint(**model.checkpoint_items)
            status = ckpt.restore(init_path)
            status.assert_consumed()
        elif module_selection == 'backbone':
            ckpt = tf.train.Checkpoint(backbone=model.backbone)
            status = ckpt.restore(init_path)
            status.expect_partial().assert_existing_objects_matched()
        else:
            raise ValueError("Only 'all' or 'backbone' are valid initialization modules.")

        logging.info(f"Pretrained checkpoint loaded from: {init_path}")

    def build_inputs(self, params, input_context=None):
        """Creates input pipeline with decoding and parsing logic."""
        decoder_opts = params.decoder.get()

        # Select appropriate decoder based on configuration
        if decoder_opts.type == 'simple_decoder':
            decoder = tf_example_decoder.TfExampleDecoder(
                include_mask=self._task_config.model.include_mask,
                regenerate_source_id=decoder_opts.regenerate_source_id,
            )
        elif decoder_opts.type == 'label_map_decoder':
            decoder = tf_example_label_map_decoder.TfExampleDecoderLabelMap(
                label_map=decoder_opts.label_map,
                include_mask=self._task_config.model.include_mask,
                regenerate_source_id=decoder_opts.regenerate_source_id,
            )
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported decoder type: {decoder_opts.type}")

        # Configure parser for data augmentation and preprocessing
        parser = maskrcnn_input.Parser(
            output_size=self.task_config.model.input_size[:2],
            min_level=self.task_config.model.min_level,
            max_level=self.task_config.model.max_level,
            num_scales=self.task_config.model.anchor.num_scales,
            aspect_ratios=self.task_config.model.anchor.aspect_ratios,
            anchor_size=self.task_config.model.anchor.anchor_size,
            dtype=params.dtype,
            rpn_match_threshold=params.parser.rpn_match_threshold,
            rpn_unmatched_threshold=params.parser.rpn_unmatched_threshold,
            rpn_batch_size_per_im=params.parser.rpn_batch_size_per_im,
            rpn_fg_fraction=params.parser.rpn_fg_fraction,
            aug_rand_hflip=params.parser.aug_rand_hflip,
            aug_scale_min=params.parser.aug_scale_min,
            aug_scale_max=params.parser.aug_scale_max,
            skip_crowd_during_training=params.parser.skip_crowd_during_training,
            max_num_instances=params.parser.max_num_instances,
            include_mask=self._task_config.model.include_mask,
            mask_crop_size=params.parser.mask_crop_size,
        )

        # Build final dataset reader
        reader = input_reader.InputReader(
            params,
            dataset_fn=tf.data.TFRecordDataset,
            decoder_fn=decoder.decode,
            parser_fn=parser.parse_fn(params.is_training),
        )
        return reader.read(input_context=input_context)

    def build_losses(self, outputs, labels, aux_losses=None):
        """Computes total loss combining all Mask R-CNN components."""
        cfg = self.task_config
        losses = {}

        # RPN losses
        rpn_score_fn = maskrcnn_losses.RpnScoreLoss(tf.shape(outputs['box_outputs'])[1])
        rpn_box_fn = maskrcnn_losses.RpnBoxLoss(cfg.losses.rpn_huber_loss_delta)

        losses['rpn_score'] = tf.reduce_mean(
            rpn_score_fn(outputs['rpn_scores'], labels['rpn_score_targets'])
        )
        losses['rpn_box'] = tf.reduce_mean(
            rpn_box_fn(outputs['rpn_boxes'], labels['rpn_box_targets'])
        )

        # Fast R-CNN classification and box regression losses
        cls_fn = maskrcnn_losses.FastrcnnClassLoss()
        box_fn = maskrcnn_losses.FastrcnnBoxLoss(cfg.losses.frcnn_huber_loss_delta)

        losses['frcnn_cls'] = tf.reduce_mean(
            cls_fn(outputs['class_outputs'], outputs['class_targets'])
        )
        losses['frcnn_box'] = tf.reduce_mean(
            box_fn(
                outputs['box_outputs'],
                outputs['class_targets'],
                outputs['box_targets']
            )
        )

        # Mask loss (optional)
        if cfg.model.include_mask:
            mask_fn = maskrcnn_losses.MaskrcnnLoss()
            losses['mask'] = tf.reduce_mean(
                mask_fn(
                    outputs['mask_outputs'],
                    outputs['mask_targets'],
                    outputs['mask_class_targets']
                )
            )
        else:
            losses['mask'] = 0.0

        # Combine weighted losses
        total_model_loss = (
            cfg.losses.rpn_score_weight * losses['rpn_score'] +
            cfg.losses.rpn_box_weight * losses['rpn_box'] +
            cfg.losses.frcnn_class_weight * losses['frcnn_cls'] +
            cfg.losses.frcnn_box_weight * losses['frcnn_box'] +
            cfg.losses.mask_weight * losses['mask']
        )

        # Add regularization losses if present
        total_loss = total_model_loss
        if aux_losses:
            reg_term = tf.reduce_sum(aux_losses)
            total_loss += reg_term

        return {
            'total_loss': total_loss,
            'rpn_score_loss': losses['rpn_score'],
            'rpn_box_loss': losses['rpn_box'],
            'frcnn_cls_loss': losses['frcnn_cls'],
            'frcnn_box_loss': losses['frcnn_box'],
            'mask_loss': losses['mask'],
            'model_loss': total_model_loss,
        }

    def build_metrics(self, training=True):
        """Sets up metric objects for monitoring training/validation."""
        if training:
            names = [
                'total_loss',
                'rpn_score_loss',
                'rpn_box_loss',
                'frcnn_cls_loss',
                'frcnn_box_loss',
                'mask_loss',
                'model_loss'
            ]
            return [tf.keras.metrics.Mean(name, dtype=tf.float32) for name in names]
        else:
            self.coco_metric = coco_evaluator.COCOEvaluator(
                annotation_file=self._task_config.annotation_file,
                include_mask=self._task_config.model.include_mask,
                per_category_metrics=self._task_config.per_category_metrics,
            )
            return []

    def train_step(self, inputs, model, optimizer, metrics=None):
        """Performs one step of forward-backward pass."""
        images, labels = inputs
        strategy = tf.distribute.get_strategy()
        replicas = strategy.num_replicas_in_sync

        with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
            # Forward pass with ground truth inputs
            outputs = model(
                images,
                image_shape=labels['image_info'][:, 1, :],
                anchor_boxes=labels['anchor_boxes'],
                gt_boxes=labels['gt_boxes'],
                gt_classes=labels['gt_classes'],
                gt_masks=(labels['gt_masks'] if self.task_config.model.include_mask else None),
                training=True,
            )
            outputs = tf.nest.map_structure(lambda x: tf.cast(x, tf.float32), outputs)

            # Compute scaled loss
            loss_dict = self.build_losses(outputs, labels, model.losses)
            scaled_loss = loss_dict['total_loss'] / replicas

            # Mixed precision handling
            if isinstance(optimizer, tf.keras.mixed_precision.experimental.LossScaleOptimizer):
                scaled_loss = optimizer.get_scaled_loss(scaled_loss)

        # Gradient computation and application
        trainable_vars = model.trainable_variables
        gradients = tape.gradient(scaled_loss, trainable_vars)

        if isinstance(optimizer, tf.keras.mixed_precision.experimental.LossScaleOptimizer):
            gradients = optimizer.get_unscaled_gradients(gradients)

        # Optional gradient clipping
        if self.task_config.gradient_clip_norm > 0:
            gradients, _ = tf.clip_by_global_norm(gradients, self.task_config.gradient_clip_norm)

        optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(gradients, trainable_vars))

        logs = {self.loss: loss_dict['total_loss']}
        if metrics:
            for metric in metrics:
                metric.update_state(loss_dict[metric.name])
                logs[metric.name] = metric.result()

        return logs

    def validation_step(self, inputs, model, metrics=None):
        """Runs inference and prepares outputs for COCO evaluation."""
        images, labels = inputs

        # Inference mode
        outputs = model(
            images,
            anchor_boxes=labels['anchor_boxes'],
            image_shape=labels['image_info'][:, 1, :],
            training=False,
        )

        # Prepare detection outputs for COCO evaluator
        det_outputs = {
            'detection_boxes': outputs['detection_boxes'],
            'detection_scores': outputs['detection_scores'],
            'detection_classes': outputs['detection_classes'],
            'num_detections': outputs['num_detections'],
            'source_id': labels['groundtruths']['source_id'],
            'image_info': labels['image_info'],
        }
        if self.task_config.model.include_mask:
            det_outputs['detection_masks'] = outputs['detection_masks']

        logs = {self.loss: 0.0}
        logs[self.coco_metric.name] = (labels['groundtruths'], det_outputs)
        return logs

    def aggregate_logs(self, state=None, step_outputs=None):
        """Accumulates evaluation results across batches."""
        if state is None:
            self.coco_metric.reset_states()
            state = self.coco_metric

        self.coco_metric.update_state(
            step_outputs[self.coco_metric.name][0],
            step_outputs[self.coco_metric.name][1]
        )
        return state

    def reduce_aggregated_logs(self, aggregated_logs):
        """Returns final evaluation metrics after aggregation."""
        return self.coco_metric.result()

import tkinter

class CustomTextWidget(tkinter.Text):
    """A Text widget variant that modifies Tab key behavior using Escape sequences."""
    
    def enable_custom_tab_handling(self):
        """Activate custom Tab key handling via Escape+Tab sequence."""
        apply_tab_modifications(self)
    
    def disable_custom_tab_handling(self):
        """Deactivate custom Tab key handling and restore default behavior."""
        remove_tab_modifications(self)

def create_custom_text_widget(master=None, config=None, **options):
    """Create a Text widget with custom Tab handling enabled by default."""
    widget_config = {} if config is None else config
    text_widget = tkinter.Text(master=master, cnf=widget_config, **options)
    apply_tab_modifications(text_widget)
    return text_widget

def apply_tab_modifications(widget):
    """Configure the widget to intercept and modify Tab key behavior.
    
    widget - a tkinter.Text instance to configure.
    """
    escape_timestamp = None
    
    def handle_key_sequence(event=None):
        nonlocal escape_timestamp
        
        # Handle Escape key press - mark timestamp
        if event.keysym == "Escape":
            escape_timestamp = event.time
            return None
        
        # Check timing between Escape and Tab
        current_time = event.time
        if escape_timestamp is None or (current_time - escape_timestamp) > 500:
            escape_timestamp = None
            return "break"
        
        # Reset escape timestamp and allow Tab insertion
        escape_timestamp = None
        return "continue"
    
    # Disable default Tab/Shift-Tab bindings
    for binding in _disabled_bindings:
        widget.bind(binding, lambda e: "break")
    
    # Preserve Control-Tab functionality
    for binding in _preserved_bindings:
        widget.bind(binding, lambda e: "continue")
    
    # Apply custom Tab handling bindings
    for binding in _custom_tab_bindings:
        widget.bind(binding, handle_key_sequence)

def remove_tab_modifications(widget):
    """Remove all custom Tab-related bindings from the widget."""
    for binding_group in (_disabled_bindings, _preserved_bindings, _custom_tab_bindings):
        for binding in binding_group:
            widget.unbind(binding)

# Bindings to be suppressed (replaced with no-op)
_disabled_bindings = (
    "<Tab>",
    "<Shift-Tab>",
)

# Bindings to maintain unchanged
_preserved_bindings = ("<Control-Tab>",)

# Custom bindings for Tab replacement logic
_custom_tab_bindings = (
    "<Escape>",
    "<Escape><Tab>",
)

@click.command()
@click.option(
    "--input-reads",
    "-r",
    type=Path,
    help="Path to Fast{a,q} input file used in evaluation",
    default=None,
    required=True,
    cls=MutuallyExclusiveOption,
    mutually_exclusive=["precomputed-index"]
)
@click.option(
    "--precomputed-index",
    "-x",
    type=Path,
    help="Path to precomputed index generated by `sketchy utils fx-sort`",
    default=None,
    required=False,
    cls=MutuallyExclusiveOption,
    mutually_exclusive=["input-reads"]
)
@click.option(
    "--results",
    "-R",
    type=Path,
    help="Path to results file produced by `sketchy evaluate`",
    default=None,
    required=True,
)
def fx_time(input_reads, results, precomputed_index):

    """ Experimental: compute time to prediction from evaluation output and input reads """

    simulator = SketchySimulator(
        fastx=input_reads, fastx_index=precomputed_index
    )

    if precomputed_index:
        feature_df = simulator.fastx_index
    else:
        feature_df = simulator.get_run_index()

    eval_results = pd.read_csv(
        results, sep='\t', names=['feature', 'prediction', 'first', 'stable']
    )

    for idx, record in eval_results.iterrows():
        first_interval, stable_interval = calculate_time_intervals(feature_df, record)
        print(
            f"{record['feature']}\t{record['prediction']}\t{record['first']}\t"
            f"{first_interval}\t{record['stable']}\t{stable_interval}"
        )


def calculate_time_intervals(feature_df, row_data):

    # Handle first detection time calculation
    try:
        first_idx = int(row_data['first']) - 1
        first_row = feature_df.iloc[first_idx]
    except (TypeError, KeyError, ValueError, IndexError):
        first_row = None

    # Handle stable detection time calculation
    try:
        stable_idx = int(row_data['stable']) - 1
        stable_row = feature_df.iloc[stable_idx]
    except (TypeError, KeyError, ValueError, IndexError):
        stable_row = None

    # Reference point: first read in the run
    baseline_row = feature_df.iloc[0]

    # Compute time differences for first detection
    if first_row is not None:
        first_time_diff = dp.parse(first_row.start_time) - dp.parse(baseline_row.start_time)
    else:
        first_time_diff = None

    # Compute time differences for stable detection
    if stable_row is not None:
        stable_time_diff = dp.parse(stable_row.start_time) - dp.parse(baseline_row.start_time)
    else:
        stable_time_diff = None

    return first_time_diff, stable_time_diff
