def build_image_processor(variant: str):
    """Build EfficientNetImageProcessor with correct preprocessing settings."""
    img_size = MODEL_CONFIGS[variant]["img_res"]
    processor = EfficientNetImageProcessor(
        size={"height": img_size, "width": img_size},
        image_mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406],
        image_std=[0.47853944, 0.4732864, 0.47434163],
        do_center_crop=False,
    )
    return processor


def generate_parameter_mapping(tf_var_names):
    """Generate mapping between TensorFlow and HuggingFace parameter names."""
    # Extract block identifiers
    blocks = sorted(set(v.split("_")[0].split("block")[1] for v in tf_var_names if v.startswith("block")))
    block_map = {b: str(i) for i, b in enumerate(blocks)}

    mappings = []

    # Stem layers
    mappings.extend([
        ("stem_conv/kernel:0", "embeddings.convolution.weight"),
        ("stem_bn/gamma:0", "embeddings.batchnorm.weight"),
        ("stem_bn/beta:0", "embeddings.batchnorm.bias"),
        ("stem_bn/moving_mean:0", "embeddings.batchnorm.running_mean"),
        ("stem_bn/moving_variance:0", "embeddings.batchnorm.running_var"),
    ])

    # Blocks
    for tf_block in blocks:
        hf_block = block_map[tf_block]
        prefix = f"encoder.blocks.{hf_block}"

        mappings.extend([
            (f"block{tf_block}_expand_conv/kernel:0", f"{prefix}.expansion.expand_conv.weight"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_expand_bn/gamma:0", f"{prefix}.expansion.expand_bn.weight"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_expand_bn/beta:0", f"{prefix}.expansion.expand_bn.bias"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_expand_bn/moving_mean:0", f"{prefix}.expansion.expand_bn.running_mean"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_expand_bn/moving_variance:0", f"{prefix}.expansion.expand_bn.running_var"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_dwconv/depthwise_kernel:0", f"{prefix}.depthwise_conv.depthwise_conv.weight"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_bn/gamma:0", f"{prefix}.depthwise_conv.depthwise_norm.weight"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_bn/beta:0", f"{prefix}.depthwise_conv.depthwise_norm.bias"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_bn/moving_mean:0", f"{prefix}.depthwise_conv.depthwise_norm.running_mean"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_bn/moving_variance:0", f"{prefix}.depthwise_conv.depthwise_norm.running_var"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_se_reduce/kernel:0", f"{prefix}.squeeze_excite.reduce.weight"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_se_reduce/bias:0", f"{prefix}.squeeze_excite.reduce.bias"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_se_expand/kernel:0", f"{prefix}.squeeze_excite.expand.weight"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_se_expand/bias:0", f"{prefix}.squeeze_excite.expand.bias"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_project_conv/kernel:0", f"{prefix}.projection.project_conv.weight"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_project_bn/gamma:0", f"{prefix}.projection.project_bn.weight"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_project_bn/beta:0", f"{prefix}.projection.project_bn.bias"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_project_bn/moving_mean:0", f"{prefix}.projection.project_bn.running_mean"),
            (f"block{tf_block}_project_bn/moving_variance:0", f"{prefix}.projection.project_bn.running_var"),
        ])

    # Top layers
    mappings.extend([
        ("top_conv/kernel:0", "encoder.top_conv.weight"),
        ("top_bn/gamma:0", "encoder.top_bn.weight"),
        ("top_bn/beta:0", "encoder.top_bn.bias"),
        ("top_bn/moving_mean:0", "encoder.top_bn.running_mean"),
        ("top_bn/moving_variance:0", "encoder.top_bn.running_var"),
    ])

    # Final classifier
    mappings.extend([
        ("predictions/kernel:0", "classifier.weight"),
        ("predictions/bias:0", "classifier.bias"),
    ])

    # Build final mapping dict, only include existing TF keys
    src_to_dst = {}
    for tf_name, hf_name in mappings:
        if tf_name in tf_var_names:
            src_to_dst[tf_name] = "efficientnet." + hf_name

    return src_to_dst


def transfer_weights(hf_state_dict, tf_weights, mapping):
    """Copy weights from TensorFlow model to HuggingFace model."""
    for tf_key, tf_val in tf_weights.items():
        if "normalization" in tf_key:
            continue

        hf_key = mapping[tf_key]
        arr = torch.from_numpy(tf_val)

        # Handle permutes based on layer type
        if "_conv" in tf_key and "kernel" in tf_key:
            arr = arr.permute(3, 2, 0, 1)
        elif "depthwise_kernel" in tf_key:
            arr = arr.permute(2, 3, 0, 1)
        elif "kernel" in tf_key:
            arr = arr.transpose(0, 1)
        # else: keep as-is

        assert hf_state_dict[hf_key].shape == arr.shape, f"Shape mismatch at {hf_key}"
        hf_state_dict[hf_key].copy_(arr)


@torch.no_grad()
def convert_model(
    variant: str,
    output_dir: str,
    save_locally: bool,
    push_to_hub: bool,
):
    """
    Convert a TensorFlow EfficientNet checkpoint to HuggingFace format.
    """
    # Load original TF model
    tf_model = EFFICIENTNET_CLASSES[variant](
        include_top=True,
        weights="imagenet",
        input_tensor=None,
        input_shape=None,
        pooling=None,
        classes=1000,
        classifier_activation="softmax",
    )

    # Collect all parameters (trainable + non-trainable)
    tf_vars = {v.name: v.numpy() for v in tf_model.trainable_variables}
    for nv in tf_model.non_trainable_variables:
        tf_vars[nv.name] = nv.numpy()

    tf_keys = list(tf_vars.keys())

    # Initialize HF model
    cfg = fetch_efficientnet_config(variant)
    hf_model = EfficientNetForImageClassification(cfg).eval()
    hf_state = hf_model.state_dict()

    # Generate and apply mapping
    log.info("Generating parameter mapping...")
    param_map = generate_parameter_mapping(tf_keys)
    log.info("Transferring weights...")
    transfer_weights(hf_state, tf_vars, param_map)

    # Inference validation
    preprocessor = build_image_processor(variant)
    pil_img = fetch_sample_image()
    inputs = preprocessor(images=pil_img, return_tensors="pt")

    hf_model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        hf_outputs = hf_model(**inputs)
    hf_logits = hf_outputs.logits.cpu().numpy()

    # Run original model
    tf_model.trainable = False
    img_res = MODEL_CONFIGS[variant]["img_res"]
    resized_img = pil_img.resize((img_res, img_res), resample=PIL.Image.NEAREST)
    np_img = np.expand_dims(np.array(resized_img), axis=0)
    tf_logits = tf_model.predict(np_img)

    # Validate match
    if not np.allclose(tf_logits, hf_logits, atol=1e-3):
        raise RuntimeError("Model outputs differ beyond tolerance.")
    log.info("✅ Model outputs match!")

    # Save or push
    out_path = Path(output_dir)
    if save_locally:
        out_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        hf_model.save_pretrained(out_path)
        preprocessor.save_pretrained(out_path)

    if push_to_hub:
        hub_name = f"efficientnet-{variant}"
        log.info(f"Uploading {hub_name} to Hugging Face Hub...")
        preprocessor.push_to_hub(hub_name)
        hf_model.push_to_hub(hub_name)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert EfficientNet TF checkpoints to HF format.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--model_variant",
        default="b0",
        choices=list(EFFICIENTNET_CLASSES.keys()),
        help="EfficientNet variant to convert.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output_directory",
        default="hf_converted",
        help="Directory to save converted model.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--save_local",
        action="store_true",
        help="Save model locally after conversion.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--upload_hub",
        action="store_true",
        help="Push model and processor to Hugging Face Hub.",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()
    convert_model(
        variant=args.model_variant,
        output_dir=args.output_directory,
        save_locally=args.save_local,
        push_to_hub=args.upload_hub,
    )

import builtins
import os
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from primus.core.launcher.config import PrimusConfig
from primus.core.utils import checker, logger
from primus.core.utils.global_vars import (
    get_cli_args,
    get_target_platform,
    set_global_variables,
)
from .module_utils import debug_rank_all, set_logging_rank


class BaseModule(ABC):
    def __init__(
        self,
        mod_name: str,
        cfg: PrimusConfig,
        worker_rank: int,
        world_size: int,
        master_addr: str = None,
        master_port: int = None,
    ):
        # Module will be initialized by multiple worker processes
        self.mod_name = mod_name
        assert cfg is not None
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.mod_cfg = cfg.get_module_config(mod_name)

        # Propagate config into global state of worker process
        set_global_variables(cfg)

        target_platform = get_target_platform()
        cli_arguments = get_cli_args()

        # Validate distributed setup requirements
        if master_port is None:
            raise ValueError("Must provide a master port for all module workers")

        if worker_rank > 0 and master_addr is None:
            raise ValueError("Must provide master addr for workers with rank > 0")

        self.worker_rank = worker_rank
        self.world_size = world_size

        # Determine master address based on rank
        if worker_rank == 0 and master_addr is not None:
            self.master_addr = target_platform.get_addr()
        else:
            self.master_addr = master_addr

        self.master_port = master_port

        # Export essential env vars for subprocesses
        os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"] = str(self.master_addr)
        os.environ["MASTER_PORT"] = str(self.master_port)
        os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"] = str(self.world_size)
        os.environ["RANK"] = str(self.worker_rank)

        # Compute local rank
        gpus_per_node = target_platform.get_gpus_per_node()
        self.local_rank = self.worker_rank % gpus_per_node
        os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"] = str(self.local_rank)

        # Initialize logging infrastructure
        self._configure_worker_logging(worker_rank, world_size)

    @abstractmethod
    def initialize(self, *args, **kwargs):
        raise NotImplementedError

    @abstractmethod
    def prepare(self, *args, **kwargs):
        raise NotImplementedError

    @abstractmethod
    def execute(self, *args, **kwargs):
        raise NotImplementedError

    def _configure_worker_logging(self, rank, total_ranks):
        # Configure logging for distributed module worker
        sink_level = self.mod_cfg.sink_level
        if sink_level is not None:
            self.mod_cfg.file_sink_level = sink_level
            self.mod_cfg.stderr_sink_level = sink_level

        log_config = logger.LoggerConfig(
            exp_root_path=self.cfg.exp_root_path,
            work_group=self.cfg.exp_meta_info["work_group"],
            user_name=self.cfg.exp_meta_info["user_name"],
            exp_name=self.cfg.exp_meta_info["exp_name"],
            module_name=self.mod_name,
            file_sink_level=self.mod_cfg.file_sink_level,
            stderr_sink_level=self.mod_cfg.stderr_sink_level,
            node_ip=self.platform.get_addr(),
            rank=rank,
            world_size=total_ranks,
        )
        logger.setup_logger(log_config, is_head=False)
        set_logging_rank(rank, total_ranks)

        # Monkey-patch print() to route through debugging utilities
        self._orig_print = builtins.print
        builtins.print = debug_rank_all

    @property
    def experiment_root(self) -> str:
        return self.cfg.exp_root_path

    @property
    def experiment_metadata(self) -> dict:
        return self.cfg.exp_meta_info

    def get_master_address(self) -> str:
        return self.master_addr

    def get_master_port(self) -> int:
        return self.master_port

    def get_worker_rank(self) -> int:
        return self.worker_rank

    def get_world_size(self) -> int:
        return self.world_size

    @property
    def configuration(self):
        return self.mod_cfg

    @property
    def is_trainable(self):
        return self.mod_cfg.trainable

"""
UI Input Control Helpers
This module provides utilities for managing user input constraints in Tkinter interfaces,
including character limits and real-time feedback mechanisms. It works alongside the
business-logic validation layer in `app/validation.py`.
"""
import tkinter as tk
from typing import Callable, Optional


def constrain_entry_input(entry_widget: tk.Entry, max_length: int, 
                         on_change: Optional[Callable[[int], None]] = None) -> None:
    """
    Enforce a maximum character limit on a tk.Entry widget with optional callbacks.
    
    Args:
        entry_widget: The tk.Entry instance to constrain
        max_length: Maximum allowed characters
        on_change: Optional callback receiving current length on each change
    """
    def check_input(proposed_text: str) -> bool:
        if len(proposed_text) > max_length:
            entry_widget.bell()  # Audible alert for overflow attempt
            return False
        
        if on_change is not None:
            on_change(len(proposed_text))
        return True
    
    # Register validation function with Tkinter's validation system
    validation_cmd = (entry_widget.register(check_input), '%P')
    entry_widget.configure(validate='key', validatecommand=validation_cmd)


def constrain_text_input(text_area: tk.Text, char_limit: int, 
                        display_counter: Optional[tk.Label] = None) -> None:
    """
    Enforce a character limit on a tk.Text widget with paste handling and counter updates.
    
    Args:
        text_area: The tk.Text instance to constrain
        char_limit: Maximum allowed characters
        display_counter: Optional label to show "current/max" count (turns red at limit)
    """
    
    def refresh_counter(current_count: int):
        if display_counter is not None:
            display_counter.config(text=f"{current_count}/{char_limit}")
            display_counter.config(fg="red" if current_count >= char_limit else "")
    
    def handle_keypress(event):
        # Permit navigation/deletion keys regardless of limit
        safe_keys = {'BackSpace', 'Delete', 'Left', 'Right', 'Up', 'Down', 'Home', 'End'}
        if event.keysym in safe_keys:
            return
        
        # Allow keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+C/V, etc.)
        if event.state & 0x4:  # Control key mask
            return
        
        # Permit text selection operations
        try:
            if text_area.tag_ranges("sel"):
                return
        except Exception:
            pass
        
        # Prevent insertion beyond limit
        current_content = text_area.get("1.0", "end-1c")
        if len(current_content) >= char_limit:
            text_area.bell()
            return "break"
    
    def handle_keyrelease(event):
        # Handle pasted content exceeding limit
        current_content = text_area.get("1.0", "end-1c")
        
        if len(current_content) > char_limit:
            # Truncate excess characters
            text_area.delete(f"1.0 + {char_limit} chars", "end")
            text_area.bell()
            current_content = text_area.get("1.0", "end-1c")
        
        refresh_counter(len(current_content))
    
    # Attach event handlers
    text_area.bind('<KeyPress>', handle_keypress)
    text_area.bind('<KeyRelease>', handle_keyrelease)
    
    # Initialize counter state
    initial_length = len(text_area.get("1.0", "end-1c"))
    refresh_counter(initial_length)

# Data Analysis Script using DuckDB (Type III Clone)
# Analyzes Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and CSV files via DuckDB's embedded SQL engine.
# Supports schema inspection, custom SQL queries, statistical summaries, and export functionality.

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import logging
import os
import re
import sys
import tempfile

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

try:
    import duckdb
except ImportError:
    logger.error("duckdb is not installed. Installing...")
    os.system(f"{sys.executable} -m pip install duckdb openpyxl -q")
    import duckdb

try:
    import openpyxl  # noqa: F401
except ImportError:
    os.system(f"{sys.executable} -m pip install openpyxl -q")

# Cache directory for persistent DuckDB databases
CACHE_DIR = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), ".data-analysis-cache")
TABLE_MAP_SUFFIX = ".table_map.json"

def compute_files_hash(files: list[str]) -> str:
    """Compute a combined SHA256 hash of all input files for cache key."""
    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
    for file_path in sorted(files):
        try:
            with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
                while chunk := f.read(8192):
                    hasher.update(chunk)
        except OSError:
            hasher.update(file_path.encode())
    return hasher.hexdigest()

def get_cache_db_path(files_hash: str) -> str:
    """Get the path to the cached DuckDB database file."""
    os.makedirs(CACHE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    return os.path.join(CACHE_DIR, f"{files_hash}.duckdb")

def get_table_map_path(files_hash: str) -> str:
    """Get the path to the cached table map JSON file."""
    return os.path.join(CACHE_DIR, f"{files_hash}{TABLE_MAP_SUFFIX}")

def save_table_map(files_hash: str, table_map: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    """Save table map to a JSON file alongside the cached DB."""
    path = get_table_map_path(files_hash)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(table_map, f, ensure_ascii=False)

def load_table_map(files_hash: str) -> dict[str, str] | None:
    """Load table map from cache. Returns None if not found."""
    path = get_table_map_path(files_hash)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        return None

def sanitize_table_name(name: str) -> str:
    """Sanitize a sheet/file name into a valid SQL table name."""
    sanitized = re.sub(r"[^\w]", "_", name)
    if sanitized and sanitized[0].isdigit():
        sanitized = f"t_{sanitized}"
    return sanitized

def load_files(con: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection, files: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    """
    Load Excel/CSV files into DuckDB tables.
    Returns a mapping of original_name -> sanitized_table_name.
    """
    con.execute("INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")
    table_map: dict[str, str] = {}
    for file_path in files:
        if not os.path.exists(file_path):
            logger.error(f"File not found: {file_path}")
            continue
        ext = os.path.splitext(file_path)[1].lower()
        if ext in (".xlsx", ".xls"):
            _load_excel(con, file_path, table_map)
        elif ext == ".csv":
            _load_csv(con, file_path, table_map)
        else:
            logger.warning(f"Unsupported file format: {ext} ({file_path})")
    return table_map

def _load_excel(
    con: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection, file_path: str, table_map: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    """Load all sheets from an Excel file into DuckDB tables."""
    import openpyxl
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    sheet_names = wb.sheetnames
    wb.close()
    for sheet_name in sheet_names:
        table_name = sanitize_table_name(sheet_name)
        original_table_name = table_name
        counter = 1
        while table_name in table_map.values():
            table_name = f"{original_table_name}_{counter}"
            counter += 1
        try:
            con.execute(
                f"""
                CREATE TABLE "{table_name}" AS
                SELECT * FROM st_read(
                    '{file_path}',
                    layer = '{sheet_name}',
                    open_options = ['HEADERS=FORCE', 'FIELD_TYPES=AUTO']
                )
            """
            )
            table_map[sheet_name] = table_name
            row_count = con.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{table_name}"').fetchone()[
                0
            ]
            logger.info(
                f"  Loaded sheet '{sheet_name}' -> table '{table_name}' ({row_count} rows)"
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"  Failed to load sheet '{sheet_name}': {e}")

def _load_csv(
    con: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection, file_path: str, table_map: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    """Load a CSV file into a DuckDB table."""
    base_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(file_path))[0]
    table_name = sanitize_table_name(base_name)
    original_table_name = table_name
    counter = 1
    while table_name in table_map.values():
        table_name = f"{original_table_name}_{counter}"
        counter += 1
    try:
        con.execute(
            f"""
            CREATE TABLE "{table_name}" AS
            SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('{file_path}')
        """
        )
        table_map[base_name] = table_name
        row_count = con.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{table_name}"').fetchone()[0]
        logger.info(
            f"  Loaded CSV '{base_name}' -> table '{table_name}' ({row_count} rows)"
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"  Failed to load CSV '{base_name}': {e}")

def action_inspect(con: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection, table_map: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    """Inspect the schema of all loaded tables."""
    output_parts = []
    for original_name, table_name in table_map.items():
        output_parts.append(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
        output_parts.append(f'Table: {original_name} (SQL name: "{table_name}")')
        output_parts.append(f"{'=' * 60}")
        row_count = con.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{table_name}"').fetchone()[0]
        output_parts.append(f"Rows: {row_count}")
        columns = con.execute(f'DESCRIBE "{table_name}"').fetchall()
        output_parts.append(f"\nColumns ({len(columns)}):")
        output_parts.append(f"{'Name':<30} {'Type':<15} {'Nullable'}")
        output_parts.append(f"{'-' * 30} {'-' * 15} {'-' * 8}")
        for col in columns:
            col_name, col_type, nullable = col[0], col[1], col[2]
            output_parts.append(f"{col_name:<30} {col_type:<15} {nullable}")
        col_names = [col[0] for col in columns]
        non_null_parts = []
        for c in col_names:
            non_null_parts.append(f'COUNT("{c}") as "{c}"')
        non_null_sql = f'SELECT {", ".join(non_null_parts)} FROM "{table_name}"'
        try:
            non_null_counts = con.execute(non_null_sql).fetchone()
            output_parts.append(f"\nNon-null counts:")
            for i, c in enumerate(col_names):
                output_parts.append(f"  {c}: {non_null_counts[i]} / {row_count}")
        except Exception:
            pass
        output_parts.append(f"\nSample data (first 5 rows):")
        try:
            sample = con.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{table_name}" LIMIT 5').fetchdf()
            output_parts.append(sample.to_string(index=False))
        except Exception:
            sample = con.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{table_name}" LIMIT 5').fetchall()
            header = [col[0] for col in columns]
            output_parts.append("  " + " | ".join(header))
            for row in sample:
                output_parts.append("  " + " | ".join(str(v) for v in row))
    result = "\n".join(output_parts)
    print(result)
    return result

def action_query(
    con: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection,
    sql: str,
    table_map: dict[str, str],
    output_file: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Execute a SQL query and return/export results."""
    modified_sql = sql
    for original_name, table_name in sorted(
        table_map.items(), key=lambda x: len(x[0]), reverse=True
    ):
        if original_name != table_name:
            modified_sql = re.sub(
                rf"\b{re.escape(original_name)}\b",
                f'"{table_name}"',
                modified_sql,
            )
    try:
        result = con.execute(modified_sql)
        columns = [desc[0] for desc in result.description]
        rows = result.fetchall()
    except Exception as e:
        error_msg = f"SQL Error: {e}\n\nAvailable tables:\n"
        for orig, tbl in table_map.items():
            cols = con.execute(f'DESCRIBE "{tbl}"').fetchall()
            col_names = [c[0] for c in cols]
            error_msg += f'  "{tbl}" ({orig}): {", ".join(col_names)}\n'
        print(error_msg)
        return error_msg
    if output_file:
        return _export_results(columns, rows, output_file)
    return _format_table(columns, rows)

def _format_table(columns: list[str], rows: list[tuple]) -> str:
    """Format query results as a readable table."""
    if not rows:
        msg = "Query returned 0 rows."
        print(msg)
        return msg
    col_widths = [len(str(c)) for c in columns]
    for row in rows:
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            col_widths[i] = max(col_widths[i], len(str(val)))
    max_width = 40
    col_widths = [min(w, max_width) for w in col_widths]
    parts = []
    header = " | ".join(str(c).ljust(col_widths[i]) for i, c in enumerate(columns))
    separator = "-+-".join("-" * col_widths[i] for i in range(len(columns)))
    parts.append(header)
    parts.append(separator)
    for row in rows:
        row_str = " | ".join(
            str(v)[:max_width].ljust(col_widths[i]) for i, v in enumerate(row)
        )
        parts.append(row_str)
    parts.append(f"\n({len(rows)} rows)")
    result = "\n".join(parts)
    print(result)
    return result

def _export_results(columns: list[str], rows: list[tuple], output_file: str) -> str:
    """Export query results to a file (CSV, JSON, or Markdown)."""
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_file), exist_ok=True)
    ext = os.path.splitext(output_file)[1].lower()
    if ext == ".csv":
        import csv
        with open(output_file, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            writer = csv.writer(f)
            writer.writerow(columns)
            writer.writerows(rows)
    elif ext == ".json":
        records = []
        for row in rows:
            record = {}
            for i, col in enumerate(columns):
                val = row[i]
                if hasattr(val, "isoformat"):
                    val = val.isoformat()
                elif isinstance(val, (bytes, bytearray)):
                    val = val.hex()
                record[col] = val
            records.append(record)
        with open(output_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(records, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
    elif ext == ".md":
        with open(output_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write("| " + " | ".join(columns) + " |\n")
            f.write("| " + " | ".join("---" for _ in columns) + " |\n")
            for row in rows:
                f.write(
                    "| " + " | ".join(str(v).replace("|", "\\|") for v in row) + " |\n"
                )
    else:
        msg = f"Unsupported output format: {ext}. Use .csv, .json, or .md"
        print(msg)
        return msg
    msg = f"Results exported to {output_file} ({len(rows)} rows)"
    print(msg)
    return msg

def action_summary(
    con: duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection,
    table_name: str,
    table_map: dict[str, str],
) -> str:
    """Generate statistical summary for a table."""
    resolved = table_map.get(table_name, table_name)
    try:
        columns = con.execute(f'DESCRIBE "{resolved}"').fetchall()
    except Exception:
        available = ", ".join(f'"{t}" ({o})' for o, t in table_map.items())
        msg = f"Table '{table_name}' not found. Available tables: {available}"
        print(msg)
        return msg
    row_count = con.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{resolved}"').fetchone()[0]
    output_parts = []
    output_parts.append(f"\nStatistical Summary: {table_name}")
    output_parts.append(f"Total rows: {row_count}")
    output_parts.append(f"{'=' * 70}")
    numeric_types = {
        "BIGINT", "INTEGER", "SMALLINT", "TINYINT", "DOUBLE", "FLOAT",
        "DECIMAL", "HUGEINT", "REAL", "NUMERIC",
    }
    for col in columns:
        col_name, col_type = col[0], col[1].upper()
        output_parts.append(f"\n--- {col_name} ({col[1]}) ---")
        base_type = re.sub(r"\(.*\)", "", col_type).strip()
        if base_type in numeric_types:
            try:
                stats = con.execute(f"""
                    SELECT
                        COUNT("{col_name}") as count,
                        AVG("{col_name}")::DOUBLE as mean,
                        STDDEV("{col_name}")::DOUBLE as std,
                        MIN("{col_name}") as min,
                        QUANTILE_CONT("{col_name}", 0.25) as q25,
                        MEDIAN("{col_name}") as median,
                        QUANTILE_CONT("{col_name}", 0.75) as q75,
                        MAX("{col_name}") as max,
                        COUNT(*) - COUNT("{col_name}") as null_count
                    FROM "{resolved}"
                """).fetchone()
                labels = ["count", "mean", "std", "min", "25%", "50%", "75%", "max", "nulls"]
                for label, val in zip(labels, stats):
                    if isinstance(val, float):
                        output_parts.append(f"  {label:<8}: {val:,.4f}")
                    else:
                        output_parts.append(f"  {label:<8}: {val}")
            except Exception as e:
                output_parts.append(f"  Error computing stats: {e}")
        else:
            try:
                stats = con.execute(f"""
                    SELECT
                        COUNT("{col_name}") as count,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT "{col_name}") as unique_count,
                        MODE("{col_name}") as mode_val,
                        COUNT(*) - COUNT("{col_name}") as null_count
                    FROM "{resolved}"
                """).fetchone()
                output_parts.append(f"  count   : {stats[0]}")
                output_parts.append(f"  unique  : {stats[1]}")
                output_parts.append(f"  top     : {stats[2]}")
                output_parts.append(f"  nulls   : {stats[3]}")
                top_vals = con.execute(f"""
                    SELECT "{col_name}", COUNT(*) as freq
                    FROM "{resolved}"
                    WHERE "{col_name}" IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY "{col_name}"
                    ORDER BY freq DESC
                    LIMIT 5
                """).fetchall()
                if top_vals:
                    output_parts.append(f"  top values:")
                    for val, freq in top_vals:
                        pct = (freq / row_count * 100) if row_count > 0 else 0
                        output_parts.append(f"    {val}: {freq} ({pct:.1f}%)")
            except Exception as e:
                output_parts.append(f"  Error computing stats: {e}")
    result = "\n".join(output_parts)
    print(result)
    return result

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Analyze Excel/CSV files using DuckDB")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--files",
        nargs="+",
        required=True,
        help="Paths to Excel (.xlsx/.xls) or CSV files",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--action",
        required=True,
        choices=["inspect", "query", "summary"],
        help="Action to perform: inspect, query, or summary",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--sql",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="SQL query to execute (required for 'query' action)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--table",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Table name for summary (required for 'summary' action)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-file",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Path to export results (CSV/JSON/MD)",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.action == "query" and not args.sql:
        parser.error("--sql is required for 'query' action")
    if args.action == "summary" and not args.table:
        parser.error("--table is required for 'summary' action")
    files_hash = compute_files_hash(args.files)
    db_path = get_cache_db_path(files_hash)
    cached_table_map = load_table_map(files_hash)
    if cached_table_map and os.path.exists(db_path):
        logger.info(f"Cache hit! Using cached database: {db_path}")
        con = duckdb.connect(db_path, read_only=True)
        table_map = cached_table_map
        logger.info(
            f"Loaded {len(table_map)} table(s) from cache: {', '.join(table_map.keys())}"
        )
    else:
        logger.info("Loading files (first time, will cache for future use)...")
        con = duckdb.connect(db_path)
        table_map = load_files(con, args.files)
        if not table_map:
            logger.error("No tables were loaded. Check file paths and formats.")
            con.close()
            if os.path.exists(db_path):
                os.remove(db_path)
            sys.exit(1)
        save_table_map(files_hash, table_map)
        logger.info(
            f"\nLoaded {len(table_map)} table(s): {', '.join(table_map.keys())}"
        )
        logger.info(f"Cached database saved to: {db_path}")
    if args.action == "inspect":
        action_inspect(con, table_map)
    elif args.action == "query":
        action_query(con, args.sql, table_map, args.output_file)
    elif args.action == "summary":
        action_summary(con, args.table, table_map)
    con.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Timeout constants (in milliseconds)
RECV_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000
RECV_TIMEOUT_OUT_MS = 300000
RECV_RETRY_COUNT = RECV_TIMEOUT_OUT_MS // RECV_TIMEOUT_MS

def is_episode_key(key: str) -> bool:
    return key.startswith("episodes-")

def is_finished_episode_key(key: str) -> bool:
    return key.startswith("finished-episodes-")

@lru_cache(maxsize=128)
def get_episode_key(episode_uuid: str) -> str:
    return f"episodes-{episode_uuid}"

@lru_cache(maxsize=128)
def get_finished_episode_key(episode_uuid: str) -> str:
    return f"finished-episodes-{episode_uuid}"

def setup_swarm_mode_routes(
    app,
    zmq_context,
    shared_mem_dict: DictProxy,
    shared_mem_dict_lock: threading.Lock,
) -> Tuple[FastAPI, Optional[Coroutine]]:
    # Initialize shared memory if needed
    if "unclaimed_episodes" not in shared_mem_dict:
        shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"] = []
    if "current_batch_rollout_pool_information" not in shared_mem_dict:
        shared_mem_dict["current_batch_rollout_pool_information"] = CurrentBatchRolloutPoolInformation()

    # -------------------------------
    # Timeout-based episode recovery
    # -------------------------------
    async def find_and_revert_timed_out_episodes() -> List[str]:
        expired_episodes = []
        current_time = time.time()
        for k, v in shared_mem_dict.items():
            if is_episode_key(k):
                status_obj: EpisodeStatus = v
                if status_obj.episode_status == "claimed":
                    elapsed = current_time - status_obj.latest_activity_timestamp
                    if elapsed > status_obj.discard_episode_timeout:
                        expired_episodes.append(status_obj.episode_uuid)
        
        for uuid in expired_episodes:
            try:
                await revert_episode_to_unclaimed(uuid, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to revert episode {uuid}: {e}")
        return expired_episodes

    def reset_context_tracker_sync(episode_uuid, shared_mem_dict):  # must be called from async context
        key = get_episode_key(episode_uuid)
        if key not in shared_mem_dict:
            return
        zmq_addr = shared_mem_dict[key].zmq_listen_result_addr
        socket = zmq_context.socket(zmq.REQ)
        socket.setsockopt(zmq.RCVTIMEO, RECV_TIMEOUT_MS)
        socket.connect(zmq_addr)
        socket.send_string("RUNNER.SPECIAL.RESET_CONTEXT_TRACKER")
        for _ in range(RECV_RETRY_COUNT):
            try:
                socket.recv_string()
                break
            except zmq.Again:
                if key not in shared_mem_dict:
                    break
                if shared_mem_dict.get("engine_status") not in ["ENGINE.ROLLING", "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST"]:
                    raise RuntimeError("Engine no longer rolling; aborting context tracker reset.")
                continue

    async def revert_episode_to_unclaimed(episode_uuid: str, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock):
        key = get_episode_key(episode_uuid)
        if key not in shared_mem_dict:
            logger.warning(f"Episode {episode_uuid} not found in shared memory; skipping unclaim.")
            return
        
        with shared_mem_dict_lock:
            if shared_mem_dict[key].episode_status != "claimed":
                if episode_uuid not in shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"]:
                    shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"].append(episode_uuid)
                return
        
        await asyncio.to_thread(reset_context_tracker_sync, episode_uuid, shared_mem_dict)
        logger.warning(f"Reverting episode {episode_uuid} to unclaimed due to timeout.")
        
        with shared_mem_dict_lock:
            if key in shared_mem_dict:
                es: EpisodeStatus = shared_mem_dict[key]
                es.episode_status = "registered"
                es.client_uuid = ""
                es.latest_activity_timestamp = time.time()
                es.llm_call_count = 0
                es.discard_episode_timeout = -1
                shared_mem_dict[key] = es
                if episode_uuid not in shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"]:
                    shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"].append(episode_uuid)

    def remove_episode_record(episode_uuid: str, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock):
        with shared_mem_dict_lock:
            key = get_episode_key(episode_uuid)
            if key in shared_mem_dict:
                del shared_mem_dict[key]
                logger.info(f"Removed episode record for {episode_uuid}.")
            if episode_uuid in shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"]:
                shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"].remove(episode_uuid)

    # -------------------------------
    # Final output delivery
    # -------------------------------
    def deliver_workflow_output_sync(episode_uuid, workflow_output, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock):
        key = get_episode_key(episode_uuid)
        if key not in shared_mem_dict:
            return
        zmq_addr = shared_mem_dict[key].zmq_listen_result_addr
        socket = zmq_context.socket(zmq.REQ)
        socket.setsockopt(zmq.RCVTIMEO, RECV_TIMEOUT_MS)
        socket.connect(zmq_addr)
        socket.send_string(workflow_output.model_dump_json())
        for _ in range(RECV_RETRY_COUNT):
            try:
                socket.recv_string()
                break
            except zmq.Again:
                if shared_mem_dict.get("engine_status") not in ["ENGINE.ROLLING", "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST"]:
                    break
                continue
        # Cleanup after successful delivery
        with shared_mem_dict_lock:
            finished_key = get_finished_episode_key(episode_uuid)
            shared_mem_dict[finished_key] = shared_mem_dict[key]
            del shared_mem_dict[key]
            if episode_uuid in shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"]:
                shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"].remove(episode_uuid)

    # -------------------------------
    # Status monitoring loop
    # -------------------------------
    async def monitor_episode_status():
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(10)
            await find_and_revert_timed_out_episodes()
            if DEBUG:
                write_dynamic_log(shared_mem_dict)

    def log_all_episode_statuses():
        grouped = {}
        for k, v in shared_mem_dict.items():
            if is_episode_key(k):
                es: EpisodeStatus = v
                status = es.episode_status
                if status not in grouped:
                    grouped[status] = []
                grouped[status].append(es)
        registered = len(grouped.get("registered", []))
        claimed = len(grouped.get("claimed", []))
        logger.info(f"Engine status: [{shared_mem_dict['engine_status']}], Registered: {registered}, Claimed: {claimed}")

    def write_dynamic_log(shared_mem_dict):
        if DEBUG:
            filepath = "./swarm_server.dynamic.log"
            lines = []
            for k, v in shared_mem_dict.items():
                if is_episode_key(k):
                    lines.append(v.model_dump_json())
            with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write("\n".join(lines))

    # -------------------------------
    # Engine lifecycle management
    # -------------------------------
    shared_mem_dict["engine_status"] = "ENGINE.OFFLINE"

    def cleanup_engine_state(shared_mem_dict_lock, shared_mem_dict):
        with shared_mem_dict_lock:
            keys_to_remove = [k for k in shared_mem_dict.keys() 
                              if is_episode_key(k) or is_finished_episode_key(k)]
            for k in keys_to_remove:
                del shared_mem_dict[k]
                if DEBUG:
                    logger.info(f"[cleanup_engine_state] Removed: {k}")
            if "unclaimed_episodes" in shared_mem_dict:
                count = len(shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"])
                shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"] = []
                logger.info(f"[cleanup_engine_state] Cleared {count} unclaimed episodes")

    # -------------------------------
    # FastAPI endpoints
    # -------------------------------
    @app.post("/sync_train_config")
    async def sync_train_config(req: SyncTrainConfigRequest):
        if VERBOSE:
            logger.info("Running /sync_train_config")
        if shared_mem_dict["engine_status"] != "ENGINE.OFFLINE":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Engine already started. Stop it first before syncing new config."
            )
        try:
            yaml_str = req.yaml_as_string
            logger.info("[sync_train_config] Received training configuration")
            if DEBUG:
                logger.debug(f"[sync_train_config] YAML content:\n{yaml_str[:500]}...")
            with shared_mem_dict_lock:
                shared_mem_dict["train_config_yaml"] = yaml_str
            logger.info("[sync_train_config] Configuration stored successfully")
            return {"success": True}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[sync_train_config] Error: {e}")
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    @app.post("/start_engine")
    async def start_engine():
        if VERBOSE:
            logger.info("Running /start_engine")
        try:
            import ray
            import tempfile
            import yaml as yaml_module
            from ajet.utils.launch_utils import execute_training_process
            from ajet.utils.config_utils import prepare_experiment_config
            from ajet.launcher import get_backbone_target, setup_environment_vars
            import multiprocessing

            if "train_config_yaml" not in shared_mem_dict:
                logger.error("[start_engine] No training config found.")
                return {"success": False, "error": "No training config found"}

            with shared_mem_dict_lock:
                shared_mem_dict["engine_status"] = "ENGINE.BOOTING"
                shared_mem_dict["booting_start_time"] = time.time()

            yaml_str = shared_mem_dict["train_config_yaml"]
            config_dict = yaml_module.safe_load(yaml_str)
            backbone = config_dict.get("ajet", {}).get("backbone", "verl")
            DEFAULT_DIR = "saved_experiments"
            experiment_dir = config_dict.get("ajet", {}).get("experiment_dir", DEFAULT_DIR)
            exp_base_dir = DEFAULT_DIR if experiment_dir == "auto" else os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(experiment_dir))

            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", delete=False, suffix=".yaml") as temp_file:
                temp_file.write(yaml_str)
                main_yaml_fp = temp_file.name
            logger.info(f"[start_engine] Saved config to temporary file: {main_yaml_fp}")

            args = SimpleNamespace(
                conf=main_yaml_fp,
                backbone=backbone,
                with_logview=False,
                debug=False,
            )

            should_debug = os.environ.get("RAY_DEBUG_POST_MORTEM", "0") == "1"
            debug_tags = os.environ.get("DEBUG_TAGS", "")
            if should_debug:
                args.debug = debug_tags

            def override_param_callback(config):
                config["ajet"]["interchange_server"]["already_started"] = True
                config["ajet"]["interchange_server"]["interchange_server_port"] = int(os.getenv("AJET_DAT_INTERCHANGE_PORT"))
                return config

            main_yaml_fp, exe_exp_base, exp_name, exp_config = prepare_experiment_config(
                yaml_path=main_yaml_fp,
                exp_base_dir=exp_base_dir,
                backbone=backbone,
                override_param_callback=override_param_callback,
            )
            env, exp_config = setup_environment_vars(args, exp_config, main_yaml_fp)

            if not ray.is_initialized():
                from ajet.utils.launch_utils import start_ray_service
                logger.info("[start_engine] Starting Ray service...")
                await asyncio.to_thread(start_ray_service, args, env)
            else:
                logger.info("[start_engine] Ray already initialized")

            p = multiprocessing.Process(
                target=execute_training_process,
                args=(
                    args,
                    get_backbone_target(args.backbone),
                    main_yaml_fp,
                    exe_exp_base,
                    main_yaml_fp,
                    env,
                    exp_config,
                    True,
                ),
            )
            p.daemon = True
            p.start()
            while not isinstance(p.pid, int):
                time.sleep(1)
            os.setpgid(p.pid, p.pid)

            cleanup_engine_state(shared_mem_dict_lock, shared_mem_dict)
            with shared_mem_dict_lock:
                shared_mem_dict["training_process_pid"] = p.pid
                shared_mem_dict["engine_status"] = "ENGINE.BOOTING"
                shared_mem_dict["booting_start_time"] = time.time()
            logger.info(f"[start_engine] Started training process (PID: {p.pid})")
            return {"success": True, "pid": p.pid}
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[start_engine] Error: {e}")
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    @app.post("/update_engine_status", response_model=BoolResponse)
    async def update_engine_status(req: UpdateEngineStatusRequest):
        if VERBOSE:
            logger.info("Running /update_engine_status")
        if req.engine_status not in VALID_STATUSES:
            return BoolResponse(success=False, failure_reason="Invalid engine status")
        prev_status = shared_mem_dict["engine_status"]
        shared_mem_dict["engine_status"] = req.engine_status
        if prev_status in ["ENGINE.ROLLING", "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST"] and req.engine_status not in ["ENGINE.ROLLING", "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST"]:
            cleanup_engine_state(shared_mem_dict_lock, shared_mem_dict)
        if prev_status == "ENGINE.BOOTING" and req.engine_status != "ENGINE.BOOTING":
            shared_mem_dict["booting_start_time"] = None
        if req.global_step is not None:
            shared_mem_dict["global_step"] = req.global_step
        if req.engine_status_detail is not None:
            shared_mem_dict["engine_status_detail"] = req.engine_status_detail
        logger.info(f"[update_engine_status] Engine status set to {req.engine_status}")
        return BoolResponse(success=True)

    @app.get("/get_engine_status")
    async def get_engine_status():
        status = shared_mem_dict["engine_status"]
        detail = shared_mem_dict.get("engine_status_detail")
        step = shared_mem_dict.get("global_step")
        return {
            "engine_status": status,

        }

    # --- Episode endpoints ---
    @app.post("/register_episode", response_model=BoolResponse)
    async def register_episode(req: RegisterEpisodeRequest):
        engine_status = shared_mem_dict["engine_status"]
        if engine_status != "ENGINE.ROLLING":
            return BoolResponse(
                success=False,
                failure_reason=f"Engine not in rolling state ({engine_status}).",
            )
        episode_uuid = req.episode_uuid
        if VERBOSE:
            logger.info(f"Registering episode: {episode_uuid}")
        es = EpisodeStatus(
            episode_uuid=req.episode_uuid,
            openai_base_url=req.openai_base_url,
            openai_api_key=req.openai_api_key,
            episode_status="registered",
            zmq_listen_result_addr=req.zmq_listen_result_addr,
            discard_episode_timeout=-1,
        )
        es.latest_activity_timestamp = time.time()
        es.llm_call_count = 0
        with shared_mem_dict_lock:
            shared_mem_dict[get_episode_key(episode_uuid)] = es
            shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"].append(episode_uuid)
        return BoolResponse(success=True)

    @app.post("/claim_episode", response_model=ClaimEpisodeResponse)
    async def claim_episode(req: ClaimEpisodeRequest):
        engine_status = shared_mem_dict["engine_status"]
        if engine_status != "ENGINE.ROLLING":
            fail_cause = f"Engine not ready. Current status: [{engine_status}]."
            advise = ""
            if engine_status == "ENGINE.OFFLINE":
                advise = "Start engine first using client.sync_train_config() + client.start_engine()."
            elif engine_status == "ENGINE.BOOTING":
                advise = "Wait for engine boot to complete (~1 minute)."
            elif engine_status == "ENGINE.WEIGHT_SYNCING":
                advise = "Weights syncing in progress (~1 minute)."
            elif engine_status == "ENGINE.WEIGHT_EXPORTING":
                advise = "Weights exporting (~1 minute)."
            elif engine_status == "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST":
                advise = "Post-rolling phase (~1 minute)."
            return ClaimEpisodeResponse(
                success=False,
                client_uuid=req.client_uuid,
                episode_uuid="",
                openai_base_url="",
                openai_api_key="",
                fail_cause=fail_cause + " " + advise,
            )
        if req.episode_type not in ["train", "eval"]:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Unknown episode_type: {req.episode_type}")

        with shared_mem_dict_lock:
            if not shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"]:
                return ClaimEpisodeResponse(
                    success=False,
                    client_uuid=req.client_uuid,
                    episode_uuid="",
                    openai_base_url="",
                    openai_api_key="",
                    fail_cause="No available episodes.",
                )
            episode_uuid = shared_mem_dict["unclaimed_episodes"].pop(0)
            key = get_episode_key(episode_uuid)
            if key not in shared_mem_dict:
                return ClaimEpisodeResponse(
                    success=False,
                    client_uuid=req.client_uuid,
                    episode_uuid="",
                    openai_base_url="",
                    openai_api_key="",
                    fail_cause="Episode disappeared during claim.",
                )
            es: EpisodeStatus = shared_mem_dict[key]
            es.episode_status = "claimed"
            es.episode_type = req.episode_type
            es.client_uuid = req.client_uuid
            es.latest_activity_timestamp = time.time()
            es.llm_call_count = 0
            es.discard_episode_timeout = req.discard_episode_timeout
            if req.throttle_policy and req.throttle_policy.current_task_id:
                es.optional_task_id = req.throttle_policy.current_task_id
            shared_mem_dict[key] = es
            base_url = es.openai_base_url
            api_key = es.openai_api_key

        if VERBOSE:
            logger.info(f"Claimed episode: {episode_uuid}")
        return ClaimEpisodeResponse(
            success=True,
            client_uuid=req.client_uuid,
            episode_uuid=episode_uuid,
            openai_base_url=base_url,
            openai_api_key=api_key,
            fail_cause="",
        )

    @app.post("/end_episode", response_model=EndEpisodeResponse)
    async def end_episode(req: EndEpisodeRequest):
        engine_status = shared_mem_dict["engine_status"]
        if engine_status not in ["ENGINE.ROLLING", "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST"]:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Engine not in rolling state. Current status: [{engine_status}].",
            )
        episode_uuid = req.episode_uuid
        workflow_output = req.workflow_output
        task_id = req.task_id
        if VERBOSE:
            logger.info(f"Ending episode: {episode_uuid}")
        assert "task_id" in workflow_output.metadata, "workflow_output.metadata must contain task_id"
        assert workflow_output.metadata["task_id"] == task_id, "task_id mismatch"
        key = get_episode_key(episode_uuid)
        if key not in shared_mem_dict:
            logger.error(f"Episode {episode_uuid} not found.")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Episode {episode_uuid} not found.")

        ep_stat = shared_mem_dict[key]
        if ep_stat.episode_status != "claimed":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Episode {episode_uuid} not in claimed status.",
            )
        if ep_stat.client_uuid != req.client_uuid:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=404,
                detail=f"Episode {episode_uuid} claimed by different client.",
            )
        if ep_stat.episode_type == "train":
            await asyncio.to_thread(
                deliver_workflow_output_sync,
                episode_uuid,
                workflow_output,
                shared_mem_dict,
                shared_mem_dict_lock,
            )
        elif ep_stat.episode_type == "eval":
            if engine_status == "ENGINE.ROLLING":
                await revert_episode_to_unclaimed(episode_uuid, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock)
            else:
                remove_episode_record(episode_uuid, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock)
        else:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Unknown episode type: {ep_stat.episode_type}")
        return EndEpisodeResponse(success=True)

    @app.post("/abort_episode", response_model=EndEpisodeResponse)
    async def abort_episode(req: EndEpisodeRequest):
        engine_status = shared_mem_dict["engine_status"]
        if engine_status not in ["ENGINE.ROLLING", "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST"]:
            return EndEpisodeResponse(success=True)
        episode_uuid = req.episode_uuid
        if VERBOSE:
            logger.info(f"Aborting episode: {episode_uuid}")
        key = get_episode_key(episode_uuid)
        if key not in shared_mem_dict:
            logger.error(f"Episode {episode_uuid} not found.")
            return EndEpisodeResponse(success=True)
        if engine_status == "ENGINE.ROLLING":
            await revert_episode_to_unclaimed(episode_uuid, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock)
        else:
            remove_episode_record(episode_uuid, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock)
        return EndEpisodeResponse(success=True)

    @app.post("/can_continue_episode", response_model=CanContinueEpisodeResponse)
    async def can_continue_episode(req: CanContinueEpisodeRequest):
        engine_status = shared_mem_dict["engine_status"]
        if engine_status not in ["ENGINE.ROLLING", "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST"]:
            return CanContinueEpisodeResponse(can_continue=False)
        key = get_episode_key(req.episode_uuid)
        can_continue = key in shared_mem_dict and shared_mem_dict[key].episode_status == "claimed"
        return CanContinueEpisodeResponse(can_continue=can_continue)

    @app.post("/is_episode_claimed", response_model=BoolResponse)
    async def is_episode_claimed(req: CheckWhetherEpisodeClaimedRequest):
        engine_status = shared_mem_dict["engine_status"]
        if engine_status not in ["ENGINE.ROLLING", "ENGINE.ROLLING_POST"]:
            return BoolResponse(success=False)
        key = get_episode_key(req.episode_uuid)
        if key not in shared_mem_dict:
            return BoolResponse(success=False)
        es = shared_mem_dict[key]
        if not es:
            return BoolResponse(success=False)
        if es.episode_status == "claimed":
            return BoolResponse(success=True)
        else:
            if req.unregister_if_not_claimed:
                remove_episode_record(req.episode_uuid, shared_mem_dict, shared_mem_dict_lock)
            return BoolResponse(success=False)

    @app.post("/get_episode_buffer", response_model=EpisodeBufferResponse)
    async def get_episode_buffer():
        result = [v for k, v in shared_mem_dict.items() if is_episode_key(k)]
        return EpisodeBufferResponse(buffer=result)

    @app.post("/update_current_batch_rollout_pool_information", response_model=BoolResponse)
    async def update_current_batch_rollout_pool_information(req: CurrentBatchRolloutPoolInformation):
        if DEBUG:
            logger.info("Running /update_current_batch_rollout_pool_information")
        try:
            with shared_mem_dict_lock:
                req.running_episode_details = None
                req.engine_status = None
                req.global_step = None
                req.completed_tasks_client_uuids = {}
                shared_mem_dict["current_batch_rollout_pool_information"] = req
            return BoolResponse(success=True)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error updating pool info: {e}")
            return BoolResponse(success=False, failure_reason=str(e))

    @app.get("/get_current_batch_rollout_pool_information", response_model=CurrentBatchRolloutPoolInformation)
    async def get_current_batch_rollout_pool_information():
        try:
            pool_info = shared_mem_dict.get(
                "current_batch_rollout_pool_information",
                CurrentBatchRolloutPoolInformation(),
            )
            pool_info.engine_status = shared_mem_dict.get("engine_status")
            pool_info.global_step = shared_mem_dict.get("global_step")
            pool_info.booting_start_time = shared_mem_dict.get("booting_start_time")
            running_details = {}
            current_time = time.time()
            for k, v in shared_mem_dict.items():
                if is_episode_key(k):
                    es: EpisodeStatus = v
                    if es.episode_status == "claimed":
                        time_diff = current_time - es.latest_activity_timestamp
                        running_details[es.episode_uuid] = {
                            "episode_status": es.episode_status,
                            "time_since_last_activity": f"{time_diff:.1f}s",
                            "discard_episode_timeout": f"{es.discard_episode_timeout:.1f}s",
                            "llm_call_count": str(es.llm_call_count),
                            "client_uuid": es.client_uuid,
                            "optional_task_id": getattr(es, "optional_task_id", None),
                        }
            pool_info.running_episode_details = running_details or None
            completed_map = {}
            for k, v in shared_mem_dict.items():
                if is_finished_episode_key(k):
                    es: EpisodeStatus = v
                    task_id = getattr(es, "optional_task_id", None)
                    if task_id:
                        if task_id not in completed_map:
                            completed_map[task_id] = []
                        completed_map[task_id].append(es.client_uuid)
            if completed_map:
                pool_info.completed_tasks_client_uuids = completed_map
            return pool_info
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error getting pool info: {e}")
            return CurrentBatchRolloutPoolInformation()

    @app.post("/stop_engine")
    async def stop_engine():
        kill_process_tree(shared_mem_dict_lock, shared_mem_dict)
        return BoolResponse(success=True)

    return app, monitor_episode_status()

import multiprocessing
import os
from unittest.mock import patch
import pytest
import torch
from vllm import SamplingParams
from tests.e2e.conftest import VllmRunner
from vllm_ascend.worker.model_runner_v1 import NPUModelRunner

MODELS = ["Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B", "vllm-ascend/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-W8A8"]

@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_name", MODELS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("token_limit", [4])
@patch.dict(os.environ, {"VLLM_ASCEND_FLASHCOMM2_PARALLEL_SIZE": "0"})
@patch.dict(os.environ, {"ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0,1"})
def test_aclgraph_mem_use(model_name: str, token_limit: int) -> None:
    # Clean up environment before test
    if "VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD" in os.environ:
        del os.environ["VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD"]

    # Shared state for capturing metrics across processes
    capture_flag = multiprocessing.Value('i', 0)
    free_mem_start = multiprocessing.Value('q', -1)
    free_mem_end = multiprocessing.Value('q', -1)

    def instrumented_capture(original_func):
        def wrapper(self):
            mem_free_before = torch.npu.mem_get_info()[0]
            ret_val = original_func(self)
            mem_free_after = torch.npu.mem_get_info()[0]

            with capture_flag.get_lock():
                capture_flag.value = 1
                free_mem_start.value = mem_free_before
                free_mem_end.value = mem_free_after

            return ret_val
        return wrapper

    # Patch method using context manager + setattr
    runner_class = NPUModelRunner
    orig_method = getattr(runner_class, "capture_model")
    patched_method = instrumented_capture(orig_method)

    with patch.object(runner_class, "capture_model", new=patched_method):
        input_prompts = [
            "Hello, my name is",
            "The president of the United States is",
            "The capital of France is",
            "The future of AI is",
        ]
        params = SamplingParams(max_tokens=token_limit, temperature=0.0)

        if model_name == "vllm-ascend/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-W8A8":
            engine = VllmRunner(model_name, max_model_len=1024, quantization="ascend")
        else:
            engine = VllmRunner(model_name)

        _ = engine.generate(input_prompts, params)

    # Assertions on instrumentation results
    assert capture_flag.value == 1, "Expected capture_model to be invoked"
    assert free_mem_start.value != -1, "Memory measurement before capture was not recorded"
    assert free_mem_end.value != -1, "Memory measurement after capture was not recorded"

    print(f"Free memory before capture: {free_mem_start.value}")
    print(f"Free memory after capture: {free_mem_end.value}")

    consumed_mem_bytes = free_mem_start.value - free_mem_end.value
    consumed_mem_gib = consumed_mem_bytes / (1024 ** 3)

    # Baseline expectations and tolerance
    if model_name == "vllm-ascend/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-W8A8":
        expected_baseline = 0.68
        safety_factor = 1.5
    else:
        expected_baseline = 0.20
        safety_factor = 1.3

    upper_bound_gib = expected_baseline * safety_factor
    upper_bound_bytes = upper_bound_gib * (1024 ** 3)

    assert consumed_mem_bytes < upper_bound_bytes, (
        f"Memory usage during graph capture exceeded threshold.\n"
        f"Actual: {consumed_mem_gib:.2f} GiB\n"
        f"Allowed: < {upper_bound_gib:.2f} GiB"
    )

    # Restore environment variable
    os.environ["VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD"] = "spawn"

import logging
from collections import defaultdict
import numpy as np
import torch
from omegaconf import DictConfig
import weathergen.train.loss_modules.loss_functions as loss_fns
from weathergen.train.loss_modules.loss_module_base import LossModuleBase, LossValues
from weathergen.train.utils import TRAIN, VAL, Stage

_logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _count_samples_per_stream(cfg) -> np.ndarray:
    """Extract number of samples per stream from configuration."""
    return np.array([stream_cfg.get("num_samples", 1) for _, stream_cfg in cfg.items()])


class PhysicalLossHandler(LossModuleBase):
    """
    Aggregates and computes physical losses across streams, timesteps, channels,
    and forecast steps during training/validation.
    
    Supports dynamic loss function loading, channel/location weighting,
    spoofed sample masking, and substep-aware loss computation.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: DictConfig,
        mode_config: DictConfig,
        current_stage: Stage,
        target_device: str,
        **loss_components,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.cfg = config
        self.mode_cfg = mode_config
        self.stage = current_stage
        self.device = target_device
        self.identifier = "PhysicalLoss"

        # Build list of active loss functions with their weights and names
        self._active_losses = [
            [getattr(loss_fns, fn_name), params.get("weight", 1.0), fn_name]
            for fn_name, params in loss_components.items()
        ]

    def _fetch_stream_weight(self, stream_meta):
        """Determine global weight for this stream based on stage."""
        if self.stage == TRAIN:
            base_weight = stream_meta.get("loss_weight", 1.0)
            ch_weights = (
                torch.tensor(stream_meta["target_channel_weights"], device=self.device, non_blocking=True)
                if "target_channel_weights" in stream_meta else None
            )
        else:  # VAL
            base_weight = 1.0
            ch_weights = None
        return base_weight, ch_weights

    def _compute_timestep_weights(self, num_steps):
        """Generate per-timestep decay weights if configured."""
        tw_cfg = self.mode_cfg.get("forecast", {}).get("timestep_weight", {})
        if not tw_cfg:
            return [1.0] * num_steps
        func_name = next(iter(tw_cfg.keys()))
        decay_param = tw_cfg[func_name]["decay_factor"]
        return getattr(loss_fns, func_name)(num_steps, decay_param)

    def _build_location_mask(self, stream_info, coords):
        """Construct spatial weighting mask if requested."""
        lw_type = stream_info.get("location_weight")
        if not lw_type:
            return None
        weight_fn = getattr(loss_fns, lw_type)
        weights = weight_fn(coords).to(device=self.device, non_blocking=True)
        return weights

    def _extract_substep_masks(self, stream_info, time_indices):
        """Create boolean masks for unique time indices (used in substep aggregation)."""
        tokenize_spacetime = stream_info.get("tokenize_spacetime", False)
        unique_times = np.unique(time_indices) if tokenize_spacetime else [time_indices]
        masks = []
        for t in unique_times:
            mask = torch.tensor(t == time_indices, device=self.device, non_blocking=True)
            masks.append(mask)
        return masks

    @staticmethod
    def _evaluate_single_loss_function(
        loss_func,
        truth: torch.Tensor,
        estimate: torch.Tensor,
        time_masks: list[torch.Tensor],
        channel_weights: torch.Tensor | None,
        location_weights: torch.Tensor | None,
    ):
        """Compute aggregated loss over substeps for one loss function."""
        total_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=truth.device, requires_grad=True)
        per_channel = torch.zeros(truth.shape[-1], device=truth.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        valid_substeps = 0

        for tm in time_masks:
            assert tm.sum() == len(location_weights) if location_weights is not None else True
            step_loss, ch_losses = loss_func(
                truth[tm], estimate[:, tm], channel_weights, location_weights
            )
            total_loss += step_loss
            if len(ch_losses) > 0:
                per_channel += ch_losses.detach()
            valid_substeps += 1 if step_loss.item() > 0 else 0

        # Normalize by number of valid substeps
        per_channel /= max(valid_substeps, 1)
        total_loss /= max(valid_substeps, 1)
        return total_loss, per_channel

    def compute_total_loss(
        self,
        predictions: dict,
        ground_truths: dict,
        meta_data: tuple,
    ) -> LossValues:
        """
        Compute final scalar loss and detailed per-stream/per-channel metrics.

        Aggregates over:
          - streams (e.g., surface, upper-air)
          - forecast steps
          - loss functions (e.g., MSE, MAE, KL)
          - channels
          - substeps (if spacetime tokenization enabled)
        """
        device = self.device
        total_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)
        active_streams = 0

        # Prepare metadata unpacking
        src2tgt_map, out_info, tgt2src_map, tgt_info = meta_data

        # Initialize tracking structures
        detailed_losses = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(dict)))
        stream_list = list(self.cfg.streams)

        for stream_cfg in stream_list:
            name = stream_cfg["name"]
            # Select appropriate channel list depending on stage
            ch_names = (
                stream_cfg.val_target_channels
                if self.stage == Stage.VAL
                else stream_cfg.train_target_channels
            )

            # Per-stream weights & channel-specific weights
            stream_wgt, ch_wgt = self._fetch_stream_weight(stream_cfg)

            # Timestep weights
            ts_weights = self._compute_timestep_weights(len(ground_truths.output_idxs))
            if len(ground_truths.physical) - len(ground_truths.output_idxs) > 0:
                ts_weights.insert(0, None)

            # Stream-level accumulator
            stream_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)
            valid_timesteps = 0

            for idx, (pred_step, true_step) in enumerate(zip(
                predictions.physical, ground_truths.physical, strict=True
            )):
                preds_here = pred_step.get(name, [])
                if not preds_here:
                    continue

                targets_here = true_step[name]["target"]
                coords_here = true_step[name]["target_coords"]
                times_here = true_step[name]["target_times"]
                meta_here = true_step[name]["target_metda_data"]
                spoof_flags = true_step[name]["is_spoof"]

                ts_w = ts_weights[idx]

                # Timestep-level loss
                step_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)
                batch_count = 0

                for pred_sample, pred_meta in zip(preds_here, out_info, strict=True):
                    # Match source to target via correspondence index
                    native_idx = pred_meta.global_params.get("correspondence", -1)
                    match_indices = [
                        i for i, m in enumerate(meta_here)
                        if m[name].global_params["idx"] == native_idx
                    ]
                    if not match_indices:
                        continue
                    assert len(match_indices) == 1
                    target_idx = match_indices[0]

                    # Location weights
                    loc_wgt = self._build_location_mask(stream_cfg, coords_here[target_idx])

                    # Per-source-target pair loss
                    pair_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)
                    lfct_count = 0

                    for lfunc, lweight, lfname in self._active_losses:
                        if lfname not in pred_meta.global_params["loss"]:
                            continue

                        y_true = targets_here[target_idx]
                        y_time = times_here[target_idx]
                        is_spoof = spoof_flags[target_idx]
                        sw = 0.0 if is_spoof else 1.0
                        spoof_mult = torch.tensor(sw, device=device, requires_grad=False)

                        if y_true.shape[0] == 0 or pred_sample.shape[0] == 0:
                            continue

                        # Reshape prediction to match target shape
                        reshaped_pred = pred_sample.reshape([pred_sample.shape[0], *y_true.shape])
                        assert reshaped_pred.shape[1] > 0

                        # Substep masks
                        masks = self._extract_substep_masks(stream_cfg, y_time)

                        # Compute per-loss-function loss
                        loss_val, ch_losses = self._evaluate_single_loss_function(
                            lfunc, y_true, reshaped_pred, masks, ch_wgt, loc_wgt
                        )

                        # Store per-channel results
                        for ch, val in zip(ch_names, ch_losses, strict=True):
                            detailed_losses[name][str(idx)][lfname][ch] = (
                                spoof_mult * val if val != 0.0 else torch.nan
                            )

                        # Accumulate weighted loss
                        weighted_loss = spoof_mult * lweight * loss_val * ts_w
                        pair_loss += weighted_loss
                        lfct_count += 1 if (loss_val.item() > 0 and sw > 0) else 0

                    step_loss += pair_loss
                    batch_count += 1 if lfct_count > 0 else 0

                stream_loss += step_loss
                valid_timesteps += 1 if batch_count > 0 else 0

            # Normalize stream loss
            denom = max(valid_timesteps, 1)
            total_loss += stream_wgt * stream_loss / denom
            active_streams += 1 if valid_timesteps > 0 else 0

        # Final normalization
        if total_loss.item() == 0.0:
            _logger.warning(
                "Total loss is zero — possible misconfiguration."
                " Verify stream support and training setup."
            )
        total_loss /= max(active_streams, 1)

        # Reorganize detailed losses into [stream][loss_fn][channel][timestep]
        organized = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(dict)))
        for stream, ts_dict in detailed_losses.items():
            for ts, lfct_dict in ts_dict.items():
                for lfct, ch_dict in lfct_dict.items():
                    for ch, val in ch_dict.items():
                        organized[stream][lfct][ch][ts] = val

        # Compute averages per stream/loss_fn
        for stream, lfct_dict in organized.items():
            for lfct, ch_dict in lfct_dict.items():
                vals = []
                for ch, ts_vals in ch_dict.items():
                    if ch != "avg":
                        vals.extend(ts_vals.values())
                avg = sum(vals) / len(vals) if vals else torch.tensor(0.0)
                organized[stream][lfct]["avg"] = avg

        return LossValues(loss=total_loss, losses_all=organized, stddev_all=None)
